title: Neurological Manifestations of Dengue in Malaysia: Two New Case Reports and a Review of Published Cases.
abstract: Dengue virus infection is a major public health concern in Malaysia and is typically characterized by a self-limiting febrile illness, although a subset of patients may progress to severe systemic complications. Among these, neurological manifestations are increasingly reported and are believed to result from either the virus's direct neurotropic effects or immune-mediated mechanisms, including molecular mimicry and autoinflammation. This case series aims to describe the spectrum of neurological complications associated with dengue virus infection and to highlight the importance of early recognition and management. We report the clinical features of two new patients with dengue infection who developed neurological manifestations during the course of their illness, together with a review of nine published cases from Malaysia. This case-based review illustrates a diverse range of neurological complications associated with dengue infection, including cerebellitis, encephalopathy, focal cranial neuropathy, Guillain-Barré syndrome and myositis. Most patients developed neurological symptoms within the first week of dengue onset. Management was largely supportive, with selective use of immunotherapy. Outcomes ranged from near complete recovery to residual neurological deficits, emphasizing the variable prognosis associated with these complications. Both patients described in this case series from our centres were confirmed to be infected with the DENV-2 serotype. In conclusion, neurological complications of dengue are clinically significant and require a high degree of clinical suspicion in patients presenting with altered sensorium or neurological deficits. Early recognition and appropriate supportive or immunomodulatory treatment remain crucial in mitigating neurological sequelae.

title: Genomic Epidemiology of Dengue Virus in Ivory Coast Reveals Five Decades of Viral Circulation with Repeated Introductions from Burkina Faso
abstract: Abstract Dengue fever is a rapidly emerging mosquito-borne disease in Africa, yet the continent remains critically underrepresented in genomic surveillance efforts. This disparity is especially pronounced in West Africa, despite phylogenetic studies being concentrated in only a few countries, such as Burkina Faso. Within this broader regional gap, researchers have yet to systematically characterize the dengue virus (DENV) lineages circulating in the Ivory Coast. In this study, we present 24 newly sequenced DENV genomes from Ivory Coast, spanning serotypes DENV-1, DENV-2, and DENV-3, collected between 2017 and 2023. Combined with publicly available sequences, we assembled the most comprehensive dataset to date for the country. We performed maximum-likelihood and Bayesian phylogeographic analyses using global background datasets and reconstructed the spatial and temporal dynamics of dengue virus circulation in Ivory Coast. Our findings reveal multiple independent introductions of DENV into Ivory Coast, predominantly from neighboring Burkina Faso. We identify five introductions of DENV-1 between 2017 and 2019 and four introductions of DENV-2 between 2015 and 2016. DENV-3 showed two separate introductions, one in 2015 and another in 2018. Notably, we also identified an early DENV-1 introduction from India around 1977, suggesting long-distance historical viral movement likely linked to colonial and post-colonial military presence. These results underscore the need for sustained genomic surveillance to monitor viral evolution and inform regional public health responses aimed at controlling dengue outbreaks in West Africa.

title_zh: 科特迪瓦 登革病毒 的基因组 流行病学 揭示了来自布基纳法索反复传入的病毒五年传播情况
source_body_en: Abstract Dengue fever is a rapidly emerging mosquito-borne disease in Africa, yet the continent remains critically underrepresented in genomic surveillance efforts. This disparity is especially pronounced in West Africa, despite phylogenetic studies being concentrated in only a few countries, such as Burkina Faso. Within this broader regional gap, researchers have yet to systematically characterize the dengue virus (DENV) lineages circulating in the Ivory Coast. In this study, we present 24 newly sequenced DENV genomes from Ivory Coast, spanning serotypes DENV-1, DENV-2, and DENV-3, collected between 2017 and 2023. Combined with publicly available sequences, we assembled the most comprehensive dataset to date for the country. We performed maximum-likelihood and Bayesian phylogeographic analyses using global background datasets and reconstructed the spatial and temporal dynamics of dengue virus circulation in Ivory Coast. Our findings reveal multiple independent introductions of DENV into Ivory Coast, predominantly from neighboring Burkina Faso. We identify five introductions of DENV-1 between 2017 and 2019 and four introductions of DENV-2 between 2015 and 2016. DENV-3 showed two separate introductions, one in 2015 and another in 2018. Notably, we also identified an early DENV-1 introduction from India around 1977, suggesting long-distance historical viral movement likely linked to colonial and post-colonial military presence. These results underscore the need for sustained genomic surveillance to monitor viral evolution and inform regional public health responses aimed at controlling dengue outbreaks in West Africa.

title: Fatal dengue cases in travellers from 1995 to 2025: A targeted review.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral disease endemic in 136 countries and territories, with over 14 million cases and more than 10,000 deaths reported globally in 2024 alone. International travellers are at risk of infection when visiting endemic regions. While dengue in travellers is well described, dengue-related mortality in this population has not been comprehensively synthesised. We compiled and critically assessed available data on reports of fatal dengue cases among international travellers over a 30-year period. METHODS: A targeted review was conducted to identify dengue-related fatalities in travellers from non-endemic countries acquiring infection in endemic regions between 1995 and November 2025. PubMed searches using terms related to dengue, mortality, and travel were complemented by hand-searching conference proceedings, national and international surveillance reports, publicly accessible national infectious disease databases, media reports, and anecdotal notifications. Cases were classified as confirmed or probable based on diagnostic method and/or inclusion in surveillance systems. Data were extracted, cross-referenced to avoid duplication, and analysed descriptively. RESULTS: Sixty-seven fatal travel-related dengue cases were identified, of which 55 were classified as confirmed/probable and 12 cases had limited information. Of the 55 confirmed/probable cases, 22 reported both country of residence and acquisition, spanning 14 endemic destinations. Confirmed/probable fatal cases occurred among patients aged <1-79 years; 25.5% were female, 21.8% were male, and in 52.7% sex was not documented. Where infection status was available, most were primary infections (9/16). Reported fatal manifestations included neurological, cardiac, haemorrhagic, and hyperinflammatory complications. Diagnostic and reporting heterogeneity was substantial, and surveillance gaps were evident. CONCLUSIONS: Dengue-related mortality among travellers is rare but likely under-recognised and underreported. Strengthened diagnostic capacity and heightened clinical awareness may support earlier recognition and management of severe cases in travellers, while harmonised international reporting systems could improve case ascertainment and contribute to future prevention strategies.

title_zh: 1995 年至 2025 年旅行者中的致命登革热病例:有针对性的回顾。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral disease endemic in 136 countries and territories, with over 14 million cases and more than 10,000 deaths reported globally in 2024 alone. International travellers are at risk of infection when visiting endemic regions. While dengue in travellers is well described, dengue-related mortality in this population has not been comprehensively synthesised. We compiled and critically assessed available data on reports of fatal dengue cases among international travellers over a 30-year period. METHODS: A targeted review was conducted to identify dengue-related fatalities in travellers from non-endemic countries acquiring infection in endemic regions between 1995 and November 2025. PubMed searches using terms related to dengue, mortality, and travel were complemented by hand-searching conference proceedings, national and international surveillance reports, publicly accessible national infectious disease databases, media reports, and anecdotal notifications. Cases were classified as confirmed or probable based on diagnostic method and/or inclusion in surveillance systems. Data were extracted, cross-referenced to avoid duplication, and analysed descriptively. RESULTS: Sixty-seven fatal travel-related dengue cases were identified, of which 55 were classified as confirmed/probable and 12 cases had limited information. Of the 55 confirmed/probable cases, 22 reported both country of residence and acquisition, spanning 14 endemic destinations. Confirmed/probable fatal cases occurred among patients aged <1-79 years; 25.5% were female, 21.8% were male, and in 52.7% sex was not documented. Where infection status was available, most were primary infections (9/16). Reported fatal manifestations included neurological, cardiac, haemorrhagic, and hyperinflammatory complications. Diagnostic and reporting heterogeneity was substantial, and surveillance gaps were evident. CONCLUSIONS: Dengue-related mortality among travellers is rare but likely under-recognised and underreported. Strengthened diagnostic capacity and heightened clinical awareness may support earlier recognition and management of severe cases in travellers, while harmonised international reporting systems could improve case ascertainment and contribute to future prevention strategies.

title: Dengue vaccine implementation in Southeast Asia: a scoping review of program design, uptake, and safety surveillance.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue vaccine programs in Southeast Asia differ in target groups, delivery, financing, eligibility, and safety monitoring, and the evidence is scattered across peer-reviewed and grey literature. OBJECTIVES: To map evidence on dengue vaccine implementation in Southeast Asia, focusing on program design, uptake, and safety surveillance, and to identify practical insights for future vaccination policies, implementation frameworks, and clinical guidelines in the region. DESIGN: Scoping review. SETTING: Southeast Asia. Population Populations eligible for or receiving dengue vaccination. METHODS: The review followed JBI guidance and PRISMA-ScR. We searched PubMed, Scopus, Cochrane, Google Scholar, WPRIM, WHO IRIS, Google, and government and regulatory websites, and checked reference lists, for sources published from 2015 to 2026 on program design, uptake, or safety surveillance. Two reviewers screened records independently. Evidence was mapped by country and concept and synthesized narratively. RESULTS: Database searches were last updated on September 8, 2026, and grey-literature and supplementary searches on November 1, 2026. Of 366 database records and 220 grey-literature links, 33 sources were included; a supplementary search added 12 (total 45). Evidence was found for six countries and none for Brunei, Cambodia, Lao PDR, Myanmar, or Timor-Leste. The Philippines ran a large, publicly funded, school-based CYD-TDV program; Indonesia combined private access with a provincial TAK-003 pilot; Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam relied mainly on private delivery. Safety surveillance was best documented in the Philippines, Malaysia, and Singapore. Uptake data were sparse: fewer than half of the >830,000 Filipino children given CYD-TDV completed three doses before the program was suspended, and the Indonesian pilot reported about 90% coverage. No uptake data were found for private-sector delivery. Nine sources were modeling or economic studies, which inform planning but do not document implementation. CONCLUSION: Dengue vaccine implementation in Southeast Asia varies in delivery, financing, and safety monitoring, and is unevenly documented, especially for uptake. Standardized monitoring and reporting of real-world vaccination programs are needed.

title_zh: 登革热 疫苗 在东南亚的实施:对计划设计、采用和安全性 监测 的范围审查。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dengue vaccine programs in Southeast Asia differ in target groups, delivery, financing, eligibility, and safety monitoring, and the evidence is scattered across peer-reviewed and grey literature. OBJECTIVES: To map evidence on dengue vaccine implementation in Southeast Asia, focusing on program design, uptake, and safety surveillance, and to identify practical insights for future vaccination policies, implementation frameworks, and clinical guidelines in the region. DESIGN: Scoping review. SETTING: Southeast Asia. Population Populations eligible for or receiving dengue vaccination. METHODS: The review followed JBI guidance and PRISMA-ScR. We searched PubMed, Scopus, Cochrane, Google Scholar, WPRIM, WHO IRIS, Google, and government and regulatory websites, and checked reference lists, for sources published from 2015 to 2026 on program design, uptake, or safety surveillance. Two reviewers screened records independently. Evidence was mapped by country and concept and synthesized narratively. RESULTS: Database searches were last updated on September 8, 2026, and grey-literature and supplementary searches on November 1, 2026. Of 366 database records and 220 grey-literature links, 33 sources were included; a supplementary search added 12 (total 45). Evidence was found for six countries and none for Brunei, Cambodia, Lao PDR, Myanmar, or Timor-Leste. The Philippines ran a large, publicly funded, school-based CYD-TDV program; Indonesia combined private access with a provincial TAK-003 pilot; Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam relied mainly on private delivery. Safety surveillance was best documented in the Philippines, Malaysia, and Singapore. Uptake data were sparse: fewer than half of the >830,000 Filipino children given CYD-TDV completed three doses before the program was suspended, and the Indonesian pilot reported about 90% coverage. No uptake data were found for private-sector delivery. Nine sources were modeling or economic studies, which inform planning but do not document implementation. CONCLUSION: Dengue vaccine implementation in Southeast Asia varies in delivery, financing, and safety monitoring, and is unevenly documented, especially for uptake. Standardized monitoring and reporting of real-world vaccination programs are needed.
abstract_zh: 背景:东南亚地区的登革热疫苗接种计划在目标人群、实施方式、资金来源、资格条件和安全监测方面存在差异,相关证据分散在同行评审文献和灰色文献中。目标:绘制东南亚地区登革热疫苗接种计划实施的证据,重点关注计划设计、接种率和安全性,并识别未来该地区疫苗接种政策、实施框架和临床指南的实用见解。设计:综述研究。地点:东南亚。人群:符合或接受登革热疫苗接种的人群。方法:本综述遵循JBI指南和PRISMA-ScR。我们搜索了PubMed、Scopus、Cochrane、Google Scholar、WPRIM、WHO IRIS、Google以及政府和监管网站,收集了2015年至2026年间关于计划设计、接种率或安全性方面的资料。两名评审员独立筛选记录。证据按国家和概念进行映射,并通过叙述性综合进行总结。结果:数据库搜索于2026年9月8日更新,灰色文献和补充搜索于2026年11月1日进行。共筛选出366条数据库记录和220条灰色文献链接,最终纳入33个来源;补充搜索增加了12个(总计45个)。证据涉及六个国家,而文莱、柬埔寨、老挝、缅甸和东帝汶则没有相关证据。菲律宾实施了一个大规模、公共资助的基于学校的CYD-TDV疫苗接种计划;印度尼西亚则结合了私人渠道与省级TAK-003试点计划;马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和越南主要依赖私人渠道进行疫苗接种。安全性方面的证据在菲律宾、马来西亚和新加坡最为充分。接种率数据较为稀少:在菲律宾超过830,000名儿童中接受CYD-TDV疫苗接种的儿童中,不到一半完成了三剂接种,且该计划在暂停前未完成;印尼试点计划报告了约90%的覆盖率。未发现私人渠道接种率的相关数据。九项来源为建模或经济研究,这些研究有助于规划,但并未记录实施情况。结论:东南亚地区登革热疫苗接种计划在实施方式、资金来源和安全监测方面存在差异,且记录不均衡,尤其是在接种率方面。需要对实际疫苗接种计划进行标准化的监测和报告。

title: DYCAST early warning system for dengue virus risk areas, Ribeirão Preto, Brazil
abstract: Dengue is currently the fastest-spreading vector-borne disease, with an estimated 100-400 million infections per year and nearly 6 billion people at risk – more than half the world’s population. However, there is no specific antiviral treatment, thus the primary method for preventing infection is through targeted control of the principal mosquito vector, Aedes aegypti . The objective of this retrospective study is to evaluate the efficacy of forecasting dengue risk using human cases and an adaptation of DYCAST: a biologically based, spatiotemporal clustering model that proved operationally successful as a West Nile virus early warning system. Results demonstrate that DYCAST provided accurate and early detection of high-risk areas for dengue in Ribeirão Preto, Brazil, including a cryptic interepidemic focus of transmission preceding a severe epidemic. Using suspected cases, DYCAST predicted 90.3% (4,237/4,690) of confirmed cases, with a mean lead time of 66.3 days prior to illness onset. High-risk cells had >10× higher relative risk of containing a confirmed case, and sensitivity and specificity were 83.8% and 72.3%. These findings suggest that DYCAST could be utilized in real time to prospectively identify areas at high risk of dengue, for rapid and precise targeting of mosquito mitigation and public education. Implementation using free, open-source software offers a scalable technological strategy for the prevention and control of dengue around the world. This article is part of the theme issue ‘The Dengue Prevention Toolbox: Integrating Biological, Social and Technological Strategies for Sustainable Control’.

title: Parental intention to vaccinate children and adolescents against dengue fever in Vietnam: An analysis using the theory of planned behavior and selected health belief model constructs.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue fever (DF) is a major public health challenge for which no specific antiviral treatment is currently approved; therefore, prevention is the primary means of control. This study examined parents' intention to vaccinate children and adolescents with the first dengue vaccine approved in Vietnam and the factors associated with this intention. METHODOLOGY/PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: A cross-sectional study was conducted from June to October 2025 among parents of children and adolescents aged 4-18 years in five schools in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Data were collected using a self-administered questionnaire based on the Theory of Planned Behavior and selected Health Belief Model constructs and analyzed using multivariable logistic regression. Among 1,242 participants, 68.7% reported an intention to vaccinate their children against DF. Compared with parents of children aged 4-6 years, those with children aged 7-11 years had lower odds of vaccination intention (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] = 0.27, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.10-0.70). Lower self-perceived household income was associated with reduced intention (aOR = 0.53, 95% CI 0.32-0.85), whereas higher perceived mosquito density around the house (aOR = 1.22, 95% CI 1.05-1.43), favorable attitudes toward the vaccine (aOR = 2.05, 95% CI 1.53-2.75), stronger subjective norms (aOR = 1.32, 95% CI 1.17-1.49), greater perceived behavioral control (aOR = 1.36, 95% CI 1.26-1.47), and better DF prevention practices (aOR = 1.44, 95% CI 1.15-1.80) were independently associated with greater intention to vaccinate. CONCLUSIONS/SIGNIFICANCE: Parents' intention to vaccinate their children against DF was associated with financial, health-system, and social factors. These findings may inform strategies that address affordability, social support, service accessibility, and trusted health communication, particularly for parents of children aged 7-11 years and those in areas with high mosquito density.

analysis_zh.methods: 使用基于计划行为理论和选定的健康信念模型构建的自填问卷收集数据,并使用多变量逻辑回归进行分析。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在 1,242 名参与者中,68.7% 的人表示有意为自己的孩子接种 登革热 疫苗。与较低 疫苗接种 意向相关的因素包括 7-11 岁儿童和较低的自我感知家庭收入,而较高的感知蚊子密度、对 疫苗 的有利态度、更强的主观规范、更强的感知行为控制和更好的登革热预防实践与较高的意向相关。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,经济、卫生系统和社会因素显着影响父母为孩子接种 登革热 疫苗的意愿,凸显了有针对性的干预措施的必要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为解决负担能力、社会支持、服务可及性和可信健康沟通问题的策略提供参考,特别是对于 7-11 岁儿童的父母和蚊子密度高的地区的父母。

title: Ambient particulate chemical components and dengue incidence: A 10-year nationwide study in Thailand.
abstract: Dengue remains a major public health concern in tropical regions, and environmental determinants are increasingly recognized as contributors to its transmission dynamics. Thailand experiences both recurrent dengue outbreaks and episodic air pollution; however, the role of particulate chemical components in dengue epidemiology remains unclear. This study examined the association between specific aerosol components and dengue incidence across 77 provinces in Thailand from 2012 to 2021. Dengue surveillance data were obtained from the Ministry of Public Health, and monthly aerosol concentrations were derived from NASA's MERRA-2 system. A Bayesian spatial modelling approach using integrated nested Laplace approximation (INLA) was applied to estimate associations between particulate components, including dust-PM2.5, organic carbon, black carbon, and sulfate, and dengue incidence, adjusting for demographic and temporal factors. A total of 837,616 dengue cases were recorded over the study period. Higher levels of dust-PM2.5 were positively associated with dengue incidence, whereas higher levels of organic carbon, black carbon, and sulfate were inversely associated with dengue incidence. These findings suggest that particulate chemical composition may contribute to spatial variation in dengue incidence, although the underlying mechanisms remain uncertain. Incorporating particulate composition into environmental surveillance systems may improve early warning models for dengue, particularly in rapidly urbanizing regions of Southeast Asia.

title_zh: 环境颗粒化学成分与登革热 发病率:泰国一项为期 10 年的全国性研究。
source_body_en: Dengue remains a major public health concern in tropical regions, and environmental determinants are increasingly recognized as contributors to its transmission dynamics. Thailand experiences both recurrent dengue outbreaks and episodic air pollution; however, the role of particulate chemical components in dengue epidemiology remains unclear. This study examined the association between specific aerosol components and dengue incidence across 77 provinces in Thailand from 2012 to 2021. Dengue surveillance data were obtained from the Ministry of Public Health, and monthly aerosol concentrations were derived from NASA's MERRA-2 system. A Bayesian spatial modelling approach using integrated nested Laplace approximation (INLA) was applied to estimate associations between particulate components, including dust-PM2.5, organic carbon, black carbon, and sulfate, and dengue incidence, adjusting for demographic and temporal factors. A total of 837,616 dengue cases were recorded over the study period. Higher levels of dust-PM2.5 were positively associated with dengue incidence, whereas higher levels of organic carbon, black carbon, and sulfate were inversely associated with dengue incidence. These findings suggest that particulate chemical composition may contribute to spatial variation in dengue incidence, although the underlying mechanisms remain uncertain. Incorporating particulate composition into environmental surveillance systems may improve early warning models for dengue, particularly in rapidly urbanizing regions of Southeast Asia.

title: Risk of severe dengue in immunocompromised adults in Thailand: A multi-centre retrospective cohort study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Case reports suggest severe outcomes in immunocompromised patients, but large cohort comparisons are lacking. We compared dengue outcomes between immunocompromised and non-immunocompromised patients. METHODS: A retrospective multicenter cohort study of patients with laboratory-confirmed dengue infection between January 2023 and June 2024 was conducted. People living with HIV (PLWH) with CD4 < 350 cells/μL, recipients of solid organ transplantation, hematopoietic stem cell transplant within 2 years, active malignancy, splenectomy or asplenia, and conditions requiring immunosuppressive agents were classified as immunocompromised. Severe dengue based on WHO 2009 criteria, hospitalization, length of stay, and 30-day mortality were primary outcomes. FINDINGS: A total of 894 dengue patients were included, including 59 were immunocompromised. Immunocompromised patients were older (median [interquartile range] age 47.0 [30.0-59.0] vs 33.5 [26.0-49.0] years) and had greater comorbidity burden (Charlson index 1 [0-3] vs 0 [0-1]). Clinical presentation was similar, although absence of fever was more common (10.2% vs 1.1%). Laboratory findings were comparable at presentation, but immunocompromised patients had lower nadir platelet counts and prolonged thrombocytopenia. Severe dengue was more frequent in immunocompromised patients (22% vs 4.9%), with higher hospitalization rates, longer stays, and mortality. In multivariable analysis, immunocompromised status (OR 3.43, 95% CI 1.61-7.31) and comorbidity index (OR 1.33, 95% CI 1.16-1.52) were independently associated with severe dengue. INTERPRETATION: This study adds to the current evidence of higher risk of severe dengue outcome in immunocompromised highlighting the need for improved strategies for prevention and treatment in this patient population.

title_zh: 泰国免疫功能低下成年人的 重症登革热 风险:一项多中心回顾性 队列研究 研究。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Case reports suggest severe outcomes in immunocompromised patients, but large cohort comparisons are lacking. We compared dengue outcomes between immunocompromised and non-immunocompromised patients. METHODS: A retrospective multicenter cohort study of patients with laboratory-confirmed dengue infection between January 2023 and June 2024 was conducted. People living with HIV (PLWH) with CD4 < 350 cells/μL, recipients of solid organ transplantation, hematopoietic stem cell transplant within 2 years, active malignancy, splenectomy or asplenia, and conditions requiring immunosuppressive agents were classified as immunocompromised. Severe dengue based on WHO 2009 criteria, hospitalization, length of stay, and 30-day mortality were primary outcomes. FINDINGS: A total of 894 dengue patients were included, including 59 were immunocompromised. Immunocompromised patients were older (median [interquartile range] age 47.0 [30.0-59.0] vs 33.5 [26.0-49.0] years) and had greater comorbidity burden (Charlson index 1 [0-3] vs 0 [0-1]). Clinical presentation was similar, although absence of fever was more common (10.2% vs 1.1%). Laboratory findings were comparable at presentation, but immunocompromised patients had lower nadir platelet counts and prolonged thrombocytopenia. Severe dengue was more frequent in immunocompromised patients (22% vs 4.9%), with higher hospitalization rates, longer stays, and mortality. In multivariable analysis, immunocompromised status (OR 3.43, 95% CI 1.61-7.31) and comorbidity index (OR 1.33, 95% CI 1.16-1.52) were independently associated with severe dengue. INTERPRETATION: This study adds to the current evidence of higher risk of severe dengue outcome in immunocompromised highlighting the need for improved strategies for prevention and treatment in this patient population.

title: Stochastic dynamics of a multi-stage dengue model with vaccination and saturated incidence rates.
abstract: Complex population movements and inherent disruptive environmental factors render it more challenging to analyse the pathogenic dengue virus. Research on epidemic mathematical frameworks may assist in protecting the economy and public health in addition to predicting the dengue epidemic's development pattern. Influenced by this, we discuss the six-dimensional S h V h I h R h -S v I v dengue stochastic epidemic model. For this stochastic system, we first verify the existence and uniqueness of a positive global solution. Next, we construct the suitable Lyapunov function to analyse the existence and uniqueness of a stationary distribution with ergodic features by Khasminskii's method. To investigate the statistical report for the existing stationary distribution by using a probability density function. This yields, the expression of the probability density function near quasi-endemic equilibrium of log-normal properties is solved by the Fokker-Planck equation. Furthermore, sufficient conditions are derived to eradicate and control the dengue transmission. Subsequently, numerical simulations are executed to validate the mathematical predictions, and the impact of environmental disturbances and key parameters on dengue transmission is taken into account as well.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究采用六维随机流行病模型(S h V h I h R h -S v I v)来模拟登革热传播。该模型的设计考虑了环境干扰和影响登革热传播的关键参数。

title: Targeting CLK1 by CRISPR tools and pharmacological inhibition modulates the innate immune response and dengue virus replication.
abstract: Alternative splicing is a key regulatory mechanism known to be altered upon viral infection. These alterations can arise both from direct viral interference with the splicing machinery and from cellular responses such as activation of innate immunity. Here, we investigated splicing changes shared between dengue virus (DENV) infection and interferon (IFN) treatment in cultured cells, the latter serving as a model for virus-independent innate immune activation. Among the common events, we identified an increased production of non-coding mRNA isoforms from the CLK1 gene, which gives rise to a kinase that phosphorylates splicing factors including SR proteins and spliceosomal components. Consistent with this finding, IFN treatment led to a reduction in CLK1 protein levels. Using stable cell lines with CRISPR/dCas9-mediated modulation of CLK1 expression, we found that silencing CLK1 enhanced the induction of immune response genes, while its overexpression attenuated it. Inhibition of CLK1 kinase activity with the pharmacological inhibitor TG003 further potentiated IFN-induced gene expression and reduced DENV replication. Altogether, these results identify CLK1 as a proviral negative regulator of IFN-stimulated gene expression and suggest that its inhibition could enhance antiviral defenses and become a target for therapeutic strategies.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨病毒感染和干扰素 治疗 如何影响剪接变化,因为选择性剪接是病毒感染过程中被改变的关键调控机制。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用培养的细胞来研究 登革病毒(登革病毒)感染和干扰素(IFN) 治疗 对剪接变化的影响,其中 IFN 治疗 作为病毒独立的先天免疫激活模型。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用 CRISPR/dCas9 工具调节 CLK1 表达,并使用药物抑制剂评估 CLK1 激酶活性对 免疫应答 基因和登革病毒复制的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现,在登革病毒感染和 IFN 治疗 激活过程中,CLK1 基因表达均增加,但 IFN 治疗 导致 CLK1 蛋白水平下降。沉默 CLK1 增强了 免疫应答 基因的诱导,而其过表达则抑制了该诱导。使用 TG003 抑制 CLK1 激酶活性进一步增强了干扰素诱导的基因表达,并减少了登革病毒的复制。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明 CLK1 在干扰素刺激基因表达中起负调控作用,其抑制可能有助于增强 抗病毒药物 防御能力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为针对 CLK1 的潜在治疗策略提供了见解,以增强 抗病毒药物 对登革病毒的防御能力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于培养细胞,可能无法完全代表体内情况,且证据基于实验性调节而非直接观察病毒在人体中的行为。证据强度为中等。

title_zh: 通过 CRISPR 工具和药理抑制来靶向 CLK1 可调节先天的 免疫应答 和 登革病毒 复制。
source_body_en: Alternative splicing is a key regulatory mechanism known to be altered upon viral infection. abstract_zh: 选择性剪接是已知在病毒感染时发生改变的关键调节机制。这些改变可能来自病毒对剪接机制的直接干扰,也可能来自细胞反应,例如先天免疫的激活。在这里,我们研究了培养细胞中 登革病毒 (DENV) 感染和干扰素 (IFN) 治疗 之间共享的剪接变化,后者作为病毒依赖性先天免疫激活的模型。在常见事件中,我们发现 CLK1 基因非编码 mRNA 亚型的产量增加,从而产生一种磷酸化剪接因子(包括 SR 蛋白和剪接体成分)的激酶。与这一发现一致,IFN 治疗 导致 CLK1 蛋白水平降低。使用具有 CRISPR/dCas9 介导的 CLK1 表达调节的稳定细胞系,我们发现沉默 CLK1 增强了 免疫应答 基因的诱导,而其过度表达则减弱了这种诱导。用药理学抑制剂 TG003 抑制 CLK1 激酶活性,进一步增强 IFN 诱导的基因表达并减少 DENV 复制。总而言之,这些结果确定 CLK1 是 IFN 刺激的基因表达的前病毒负调节因子,并表明其抑制可以增强 抗病毒药物 防御并成为治疗策略的目标。

title: Adult Immunogenicity and Descriptive Safety of TAK-003 Dengue Vaccination: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
abstract: Background: Adult TAK-003 data differ by formulation, baseline dengue status, coadministration, and outcome definition. Objective: To synthesize adult immunogenicity and safety of the licensed two-dose final formulation of TAK-003. Methods: We searched PubMed, Scopus, CENTRAL-derived records, registries, regulatory sources, and citations to the final search update. Screening, extraction, appraisal, and analysis used a reproducible computational workflow without independent duplicate verification. Seropositivity and 270-day serious adverse event (SAE) risk were modeled with binomial-normal logit models; comparative reactogenicity used random-effects risk ratios with modified Hartung-Knapp intervals. Certainty was graded by outcome, and a sensitivity analysis added the single-arm DEN307 cohort. Results: Of 1,090 records, 606 unique records (553 publications and 53 registry records) were screened; 473 publications were excluded and 80 were retrieved. Five trials supplied quantitative outcomes. Among 620 baseline-seronegative adults, pooled seropositivity about 30 days after dose 2 was 98.7% for DENV-1 (95% CI 95.8–99.6), 99.0% for DENV-2 (97.9–99.6), 96.9% for DENV-3 (95.2–98.0), and 98.4% for DENV-4 (97.0–99.1). With DEN307 added, estimates were 98.8%, 99.2%, 97.1%, and 98.5% (752 participants per serotype). Across four cohorts, 29/1,468 participants had an SAE through day 270 (pooled risk 2.0%, 95% CI 1.4–2.8). Pain and headache estimates, each from two studies, were highly imprecise. Conclusion: Final-formulation TAK-003 gave high short-term seropositivity in selected adult trial populations. The SAE risk was uncontrolled and does not establish comparative safety. Certainty was low or very low, and inference is limited by study size, surrogate outcomes, and uncontrolled safety data.

title_zh: TAK-003 登革热 疫苗接种 的成人免疫原性和描述性安全性:系统评价和荟萃分析
source_body_en: Background: Adult TAK-003 data differ by formulation, baseline dengue status, coadministration, and outcome definition. Objective: To synthesize adult immunogenicity and safety of the licensed two-dose final formulation of TAK-003. Methods: We searched PubMed, Scopus, CENTRAL-derived records, registries, regulatory sources, and citations to the final search update. Screening, extraction, appraisal, and analysis used a reproducible computational workflow without independent duplicate verification. Seropositivity and 270-day serious adverse event (SAE) risk were modeled with binomial-normal logit models; comparative reactogenicity used random-effects risk ratios with modified Hartung-Knapp intervals. Certainty was graded by outcome, and a sensitivity analysis added the single-arm DEN307 cohort. Results: Of 1,090 records, 606 unique records (553 publications and 53 registry records) were screened; 473 publications were excluded and 80 were retrieved. Five trials supplied quantitative outcomes. Among 620 baseline-seronegative adults, pooled seropositivity about 30 days after dose 2 was 98.7% for DENV-1 (95% CI 95.8–99.6), 99.0% for DENV-2 (97.9–99.6), 96.9% for DENV-3 (95.2–98.0), and 98.4% for DENV-4 (97.0–99.1). With DEN307 added, estimates were 98.8%, 99.2%, 97.1%, and 98.5% (752 participants per serotype). Across four cohorts, 29/1,468 participants had an SAE through day 270 (pooled risk 2.0%, 95% CI 1.4–2.8). Pain and headache estimates, each from two studies, were highly imprecise. Conclusion: Final-formulation TAK-003 gave high short-term seropositivity in selected adult trial populations. The SAE risk was uncontrolled and does not establish comparative safety. Certainty was low or very low, and inference is limited by study size, surrogate outcomes, and uncontrolled safety data.

title: Diagnostic accuracy of the AST-to-Platelet Ratio Index (APRI) for severe or complicated dengue: a systematic review and meta-analysis
abstract: Background This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of APRI for identifying severe or complicated dengue, according to the target-condition definitions used in the included studies. A separate sensitivity analysis was restricted to studies comparing severe with non-severe dengue. The review also examined methodological limitations affecting the interpretation and potential clinical applicability of the findings. Objective To evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of the aspartate aminotransferase-to-platelet ratio index for identifying severe or complicated dengue. Methods Seven electronic databases were searched from inception to March 13, 2026. Eligible studies evaluated the index among patients with laboratory-confirmed dengue. The review followed the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses of Diagnostic Test Accuracy Studies guidance. Study-level sensitivity and specificity were calculated from extracted or reconstructed two-by-two data. Pooled estimates were obtained using a frequentist bivariate random-effects Reitsma model fitted by restricted maximum likelihood estimation. Heterogeneity, threshold effects and sensitivity analyses were assessed. Results Eight studies were included in the qualitative synthesis, of which six comprising 948 participants were quantitatively pooled. Pooled sensitivity was 0.75 (95% confidence interval: 0.66–0.82), and pooled specificity was 0.80 (95% confidence interval: 0.76–0.84). The positive likelihood ratio was 3.76, the negative likelihood ratio was 0.32 and the diagnostic odds ratio was 12.42. The area under the summary receiver operating characteristic curve was 0.841. Leave-one-out analyses produced similar estimates. Restriction to four studies comparing severe with non-severe dengue yielded a sensitivity of 0.73, specificity of 0.79 and area under the curve of 0.821. Conclusion APRI demonstrated moderate diagnostic accuracy for the heterogeneous target condition of severe or complicated dengue. These pooled estimates should not be interpreted as applying exclusively to strictly defined severe dengue. Variation in target-condition definitions and the wide range of retrospectively selected APRI thresholds limit clinical applicability, while retrospective threshold selection may overestimate diagnostic performance. Prospective validation is required before routine use alongside clinical assessment and serial laboratory monitoring.

title_zh: AST 与血小板比率指数 (APRI) 对严重或复杂登革热的诊断准确性:系统评价和荟萃分析
source_body_en: Background This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of APRI for identifying severe or complicated dengue, according to the target-condition definitions used in the included studies. A separate sensitivity analysis was restricted to studies comparing severe with non-severe dengue. The review also examined methodological limitations affecting the interpretation and potential clinical applicability of the findings. Objective To evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of the aspartate aminotransferase-to-platelet ratio index for identifying severe or complicated dengue. Methods Seven electronic databases were searched from inception to March 13, 2026. Eligible studies evaluated the index among patients with laboratory-confirmed dengue. The review followed the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses of Diagnostic Test Accuracy Studies guidance. Study-level sensitivity and specificity were calculated from extracted or reconstructed two-by-two data. Pooled estimates were obtained using a frequentist bivariate random-effects Reitsma model fitted by restricted maximum likelihood estimation. Heterogeneity, threshold effects and sensitivity analyses were assessed. Results Eight studies were included in the qualitative synthesis, of which six comprising 948 participants were quantitatively pooled. Pooled sensitivity was 0.75 (95% confidence interval: 0.66–0.82), and pooled specificity was 0.80 (95% confidence interval: 0.76–0.84). The positive likelihood ratio was 3.76, the negative likelihood ratio was 0.32 and the diagnostic odds ratio was 12.42. The area under the summary receiver operating characteristic curve was 0.841. Leave-one-out analyses produced similar estimates. Restriction to four studies comparing severe with non-severe dengue yielded a sensitivity of 0.73, specificity of 0.79 and area under the curve of 0.821. Conclusion APRI demonstrated moderate diagnostic accuracy for the heterogeneous target condition of severe or complicated dengue. These pooled estimates should not be interpreted as applying exclusively to strictly defined severe dengue. Variation in target-condition definitions and the wide range of retrospectively selected APRI thresholds limit clinical applicability, while retrospective threshold selection may overestimate diagnostic performance. Prospective validation is required before routine use alongside clinical assessment and serial laboratory monitoring.
abstract_zh: 背景 本系统回顾和荟萃分析旨在根据纳入研究中使用的目标条件定义,评估 APRI 识别严重或复杂登革热的诊断准确性。单独的敏感性分析仅限于比较严重与非 重症登革热 的研究。该综述还研究了影响研究结果的解释和潜在临床适用性的方法学局限性。目的评价天冬氨酸转氨酶与血小板比值指数对重症或复杂性登革热的诊断准确性。方法 检索了从成立到 2026 年 3 月 13 日的七个电子数据库。符合条件的研究评估了实验室确诊的登革热患者的指数。该审查遵循诊断测试准确性研究的系统审查和荟萃分析的首选报告项目指南。研究水平的敏感性和特异性是根据提取或重建的两两数据计算的。使用通过限制最大似然估计拟合的频率论双变量随机效应 Reitsma 模型获得汇总估计值。评估了异质性、阈值效应和敏感性分析。结果 定性综合中纳入了 8 项研究,其中 6 项研究(948 名参与者)被定量汇总。汇总敏感性为 0.75(95% 置信区间:0.66–0.82),汇总特异性为 0.80(95% 置信区间:0.76–0.84)。阳性似然比为3.76,阴性似然比为0.32,诊断优势比为12.42。汇总受试者工作特征曲线下面积为 0.841。留一法分析产生了类似的估计。限制四项比较严重与非 重症登革热 的研究得出的敏感性为 0.73,特异性为 0.79,曲线下面积为 0.821。结论 APRI 对严重或复杂登革热的异质目标病症表现出中等的诊断准确性。这些汇总估计值不应被解释为专门适用于严格定义的 重症登革热。目标条件定义的变化和回顾性选择的 APRI 阈值范围广泛限制了临床适用性,而回顾性阈值选择可能会高估诊断性能。在常规使用之前需要进行前瞻性验证以及临床评估和连续实验室监测。

title: Reticulon-3 at the Interface of Hepatitis C and Dengue Virus Infection: Extracellular Vesicle-Mediated Transfer and Emerging Antiviral Vulnerabilities
abstract: Positive-sense RNA viruses are commonly classified by genome organization, entry route, tissue tropism, and clinical syndrome, but these categories do not explain how viruses construct protected replication niches or route infectious material between cells. The endoplasmic reticulum (ER) provides a shared platform for viral translation, replication-organelle formation, membrane curvature, lipid remodeling, innate immune regulation, and vesicular trafficking. Within this framework, reticulon-3 (RTN3) has emerged as a candidate regulator linking ER-based RNA-virus replication to the generation of infectious extracellular-vesicle cargo. Hepatitis C virus (HCV) and dengue virus (DENV) provide complementary experimental settings for evaluating this model despite their distinct transmission routes, tissue tropisms, disease courses, and immune pathophysiology. HCV most clearly demonstrates that exosome-enriched fractions can transfer replication-competent viral RNA with defined host cofactors, whereas DENV provides an acute infection model for examining related transfer phenotypes. Both viruses nevertheless replicate within remodeled ER membranes and can transfer infection-competent material in a vesicle-associated form. Functional perturbation studies implicate RTN3 in the output of infection-associated vesicle preparations, but do not yet establish direct recognition of viral RNA or its incorporation into endosomal intraluminal vesicles. RTN3 can also restrict HCV replication through NS4B interactions, suggesting that its effects vary by endpoint and may reflect distinct functions at different stages of infection. Related membrane-remodeling and vesicle-associated processes in Zika virus, West Nile virus, enteroviruses, SARS-CoV-2, and hepatitis A virus illustrate broader exploitation of host membrane organization, but replication-membrane phenotypes and vesicle-associated dissemination in these systems do not establish an RTN3-dependent infectious EV pathway. In selected models, EV-enriched preparations contain protected viral cargo and transfer biological activity to recipient cells; neither particle enrichment nor infectivity alone resolves the carrier’s identity. Advances in isolation and characterization, including density-gradient or size-exclusion separation, immunoaffinity selection, particle and marker profiling, membrane-protection assays, and recipient-cell infectivity testing, now permit more rigorous identification of defined vesicle populations, protected cargo, and biological activity. Nevertheless, RTN3 should not be considered a universal RNA-virus dependency, nor should extracellular-vesicle release be assumed to generate uniformly infectious populations. Instead, HCV and DENV support functional involvement of RTN3 in vesicle-associated output, while the molecular connection between ER organization and selective cargo enclosure remains unresolved. Defining these shared and virus-specific dependencies may reveal host–virus interfaces suitable for broad-spectrum or resistance-resilient intervention, provided that infection-selective reliance, a measurable therapeutic window, and preservation of essential host-cell functions can be demonstrated.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore how viruses construct protected replication niches and transfer infectious material between cells, highlighting the limitations of current classification systems based on genome organization, entry route, tissue tropism, and clinical syndrome.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study utilized Hepatitis C virus (HCV) and dengue virus (DENV) as complementary models to evaluate the role of reticulon-3 (RTN3) in viral replication and extracellular-vesicle-mediated transfer, despite their distinct transmission routes, tissue tropisms, and disease courses.
analysis.methods: The research employed advanced isolation and characterization techniques, including density-gradient or size-exclusion separation, immunoaffinity selection, particle and marker profiling, membrane-protection assays, and recipient-cell infectivity testing to identify defined vesicle populations, protected cargo, and biological activity.
analysis.main_results: HCV and DENV both replicate within remodeled ER membranes and can transfer infection-competent material in a vesicle-associated form, but the molecular connection between ER organization and selective cargo enclosure remains unresolved.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that RTN3 plays a functional role in vesicle-associated output for HCV and DENV, but its involvement is not universal across all RNA viruses, and the precise mechanism of cargo selection is not yet established.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that understanding RTN3's role in viral replication and dissemination could inform the development of broad-spectrum antiviral interventions targeting host-virus interactions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study acknowledges that RTN3 is not a universal RNA-virus dependency, and extracellular-vesicle release does not guarantee uniformly infectious populations, indicating the need for further research to confirm these mechanisms.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of reticulon-3 (RTN3) in the replication and dissemination of dengue virus (DENV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV). It highlights the limitations of current classification systems for RNA viruses and explores how these viruses utilize the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) for replication and vesicle-mediated transfer. The research employs advanced techniques to isolate and characterize extracellular vesicles, revealing that both DENV and HCV can transfer infectious material through vesicles, but the molecular mechanisms linking ER organization to selective cargo enclosure remain unclear. The study suggests that RTN3 may play a functional role in this process for DENV and HCV, though its involvement is not universal. These findings could inform the development of antiviral strategies targeting host-virus interactions, but the evidence is limited by the unresolved mechanisms and the lack of direct confirmation of RTN3's role in viral RNA recognition and incorporation. The study's results are based on abstract-only evidence, and the confidence in these findings is moderate due to the absence of detailed experimental data.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探索病毒如何构建受保护的复制生态位并在细胞之间转移感染物质,强调当前基于 基因组 组织、进入途径、组织向性和临床综合征的分类系统的局限性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 和 登革病毒 (DENV) 作为补充模型来评估 reticulon-3 (RTN3) 在病毒复制和细胞外囊泡介导的转移中的作用,尽管它们具有不同的 传播 途径、组织向性和疾病过程。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究采用了先进的分离和表征技术,包括密度梯度或尺寸排阻分离、免疫亲和选择、颗粒和标记物分析、膜保护测定和受体细胞感染性测试,以鉴定确定的囊泡群体、受保护的货物和生物活性。
analysis_zh.main_results: HCV和DENV都在重塑的内质网膜内复制,并且可以以囊泡相关形式转移具有感染能力的物质,但内质网组织和选择性货物外壳之间的分子联系仍未解决。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,RTN3 在 HCV 和 DENV 的囊泡相关输出中发挥功能性作用,但它的参与并不普遍存在于所有 RNA 病毒中,并且货物选择的精确机制尚未建立。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,了解RTN3在病毒复制和传播中的作用可以为针对宿主-病毒相互作用的广谱抗病毒药物干预措施的开发提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究承认RTN3不是一种普遍的RNA病毒依赖性,并且细胞外囊泡的释放并不能保证均匀的感染群体,这表明需要进一步的研究来证实这些机制。

title: Persistent Wolbachia-mediated dengue virus blocking in Aedes aegypti five years after deployment in New Caledonia
abstract: Abstract Background Wolbachia infection reduces dengue virus (DENV) transmission by Aedes aegypti , but the temporal dynamics underlying this effect remain incompletely characterized in field-relevant mosquito populations. Here, we compare DENV vector competence and viral replication kinetics between Wolbachia -infected Ae. aegypti from Noumea and a Wolbachia -free population from Ouvea, New Caledonia. Methods Female mosquitoes were orally infected with DENV-2 and sampled at 3, 7, 14, 21, 28, and 35 days post-infection (dpi). Infection, dissemination, and transmission were assessed, and viral titers were quantified in the abdomen, head-thorax, and saliva. Vector competence endpoints were analyzed using logistic regression, while viral titers were analyzed using linear models. The extrinsic incubation period (EIP) was estimated from transmission kinetics. Results Across all time points, DENV infection, dissemination, and transmission were markedly reduced in Wolbachia -infected mosquitoes from Noumea compared with Wolbachia -free population from Ouvea, with infection detected in 10.1% versus 86.7% of mosquitoes, dissemination in 3.4% versus 75.8%, and transmission in 1.7% versus 31.5%, respectively. After adjustment for dpi, the odds ratio of infection, dissemination, and transmission were strongly reduced in Noumea. The population effect on infection varied significantly over time, whereas no population × dpi interaction was detected for dissemination or transmission. The estimated EIP 25 and EIP 50 were delayed in Noumea compared with Ouvea, reaching 23.9 and 24.5 days, respectively, versus 14.4 and 17.6 days in Ouvea. Viral titers were also lower in Noumea, with significant population × dpi interactions in the abdomen and head-thorax. No significant interaction was detected in saliva, although comparisons were limited by the very low number of virus-positive Noumea mosquitoes at several time points. Conclusions Wolbachia infection strongly reduced DENV vector competence in the Noumea population five years after field release, with reduced vector competence and reduced viral titers. These findings demonstrate sustained functional pathogen blocking even after long period in field conditions and support the continued effectiveness of Wolbachia -based dengue control.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand the temporal dynamics of Wolbachia-mediated dengue virus (DENV) blocking in Aedes aegypti populations five years after field release in New Caledonia, addressing the incompletely characterized effect of Wolbachia on DENV transmission.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study compared DENV vector competence and viral replication kinetics between Wolbachia-infected Ae. aegypti from Noumea and a Wolbachia-free population from Ouvea, New Caledonia, over a period of five years post-field release.
analysis_en.methods: Female mosquitoes were orally infected with DENV-2 and sampled at various time points post-infection. Infection, dissemination, and transmission were assessed, and viral titers were quantified in different body parts using logistic regression and linear models. The extrinsic incubation period (EIP) was estimated from transmission kinetics.
analysis_en.main_results: Across all time points, DENV infection, dissemination, and transmission were significantly reduced in Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes from Noumea compared to the Wolbachia-free population from Ouvea. The odds ratio of infection, dissemination, and transmission were strongly reduced in Noumea. The EIP was also delayed in the Noumea population. Viral titers were lower in the Noumea population, with significant population × dpi interactions in the abdomen and head-thorax.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate sustained functional pathogen blocking of DENV in the Noumea population five years after field release, supporting the continued effectiveness of Wolbachia-based dengue control.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results have implications for the long-term effectiveness of Wolbachia-based dengue control strategies, indicating that the reduction in DENV transmission persists over extended periods in field conditions.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study design limitations include the potential for confounding factors and the need for larger sample sizes to confirm the population effect on infection over time. The evidence strength is moderate due to the observational nature of the study and the limited number of virus-positive mosquitoes in the Noumea population at several time points.

title_zh: 在新喀里多尼亚部署五年后,沃尔巴克氏体介导的埃及伊蚊 登革病毒 持续阻断
source_body_en: Abstract Background Wolbachia infection reduces dengue virus (DENV) transmission by Aedes aegypti , but the temporal dynamics underlying this effect remain incompletely characterized in field-relevant mosquito populations. Here, we compare DENV vector competence and viral replication kinetics between Wolbachia -infected Ae. aegypti from Noumea and a Wolbachia -free population from Ouvea, New Caledonia. Methods Female mosquitoes were orally infected with DENV-2 and sampled at 3, 7, 14, 21, 28, and 35 days post-infection (dpi). Infection, dissemination, and transmission were assessed, and viral titers were quantified in the abdomen, head-thorax, and saliva. Vector competence endpoints were analyzed using logistic regression, while viral titers were analyzed using linear models. The extrinsic incubation period (EIP) was estimated from transmission kinetics. Results Across all time points, DENV infection, dissemination, and transmission were markedly reduced in Wolbachia -infected mosquitoes from Noumea compared with Wolbachia -free population from Ouvea, with infection detected in 10.1% versus 86.7% of mosquitoes, dissemination in 3.4% versus 75.8%, and transmission in 1.7% versus 31.5%, respectively. After adjustment for dpi, the odds ratio of infection, dissemination, and transmission were strongly reduced in Noumea. The population effect on infection varied significantly over time, whereas no population × dpi interaction was detected for dissemination or transmission. The estimated EIP 25 and EIP 50 were delayed in Noumea compared with Ouvea, reaching 23.9 and 24.5 days, respectively, versus 14.4 and 17.6 days in Ouvea. Viral titers were also lower in Noumea, with significant population × dpi interactions in the abdomen and head-thorax. No significant interaction was detected in saliva, although comparisons were limited by the very low number of virus-positive Noumea mosquitoes at several time points. Conclusions Wolbachia infection strongly reduced DENV vector competence in the Noumea population five years after field release, with reduced vector competence and reduced viral titers. These findings demonstrate sustained functional pathogen blocking even after long period in field conditions and support the continued effectiveness of Wolbachia -based dengue control.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 沃尔巴克氏体感染可减少埃及伊蚊的 登革病毒 (DENV) 传播,但这种效应背后的时间动态在现场相关蚊子种群中仍未完全表征。在这里,我们比较了沃尔巴克氏体感染的伊蚊之间的 DENV 媒介 能力和病毒复制动力学。来自努美阿的埃及伊蚊和来自新喀里多尼亚乌韦亚的无沃尔巴克氏体的种群。方法 雌性蚊子经口感染 DENV-2,并在感染后 3、7、14、21、28 和 35 天(dpi)采样。对感染、传播和 传播 进行了评估,并对腹部、头胸部和唾液中的病毒滴度进行了定量。使用逻辑回归分析 媒介 能力终点,而使用线性模型分析病毒滴度。根据 传播 动力学估计外源潜伏期 (EIP)。结果 在所有时间点上,与乌韦亚无沃尔巴克氏体蚊群相比,努美阿感染沃尔巴克氏体的蚊子中的 DENV 感染、传播和 传播 均显着减少,检测到感染的蚊子分别为 10.1% 和 86.7%,传播分别为 3.4% 和 75.8%,传播 分别为 1.7% 和 31.5%。调整 dpi 后,努美阿的感染、传播和 传播 的比值比大幅降低。人群对感染的影响随时间显着变化,而没有检测到传播或 传播 的人群 × dpi 交互作用。与乌韦阿相比,努美阿的估计 EIP 25 和 EIP 50 延迟,分别达到 23.9 和 24.5 天,而乌韦阿则为 14.4 和 17.6 天。努美阿的病毒滴度也较低,腹部和头胸部存在显着的群体× dpi 相互作用。尽管比较受到几个时间点病毒阳性努美阿蚊子数量极少的限制,但在唾液中没有检测到显着的相互作用。结论 沃尔巴克氏体感染在野外释放五年后,强烈降低了努美阿种群中的 DENV 媒介 能力,媒介 能力降低,病毒滴度降低。这些发现表明,即使在野外条件下长时间使用后,仍能持续发挥功能性病原体阻断作用,并支持基于沃尔巴克氏体的登革热控制的持续有效性。

title: Antiviral activity of Clinacanthus siamensis Bremek ethanolic extract against dengue virus serotype 2 infection
abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) infection causes dengue fever and can progress to severe, life-threatening diseases. Currently, no specific antiviral therapy is available, and although vaccines exist, their variable efficacy across DENV serotypes raises safety concerns. Therefore, the identification of effective antiviral agents remains critical for reducing disease severity and limiting viral transmission. This study evaluated the antiviral activity of the Thai medicinal herb Clinacanthus siamensis against DENV infection. An ethanolic extract of C. siamensis was evaluated using in vitro DENV infection assays and demonstrated significant antiviral activity, with an IC50 value of 19.32 μg/mL. The inhibitory mechanism of the extract was evaluated across multiple stages of the viral life cycle using time-of-addition experiments, including pre-treatment, co-treatment, and post-infection conditions, in which the virus was exposed to the extract before, during, and after viral entry, respectively. The pre-treatment condition demonstrated the highest level of inhibition, with the extract reducing viral protein levels to 92.79 ± 7.74%, 60.30 ± 9.79%, and 12.52 ± 10.18% at concentrations of 15.625, 31.25, and 62.5 μg/mL, respectively. These findings suggest that the extract exerts its antiviral activity predominantly at an early stage of infection. This observation was further supported by virus-binding assays, which demonstrated that pretreatment of viral particles with the extract impaired their subsequent ability to bind to host cells, suggesting a direct effect on viral particles that may contribute to reduced viral infectivity. In addition, the bioactive constituents of the extract were characterized using LC–MS/MS analysis, which identified two compounds with reported antiviral activity, including isoferulic acid and luteolin, that may contribute to the observed anti-DENV effects. These findings demonstrate that C. siamensis possesses potent anti-DENV activity by reducing viral infectivity at an early stage of infection and highlights the potential of C. siamensis for future development as an affordable therapeutic candidate against DENV​ infection.

abstract_zh: 登革病毒 (DENV) 感染会导致 登革热,并可能发展为严重的危及生命的疾病。目前,尚无特定的 抗病毒药物 疗法可用,尽管 疫苗 存在,但其在 DENV 血清型中的不同疗效引起了安全性担忧。因此,鉴定有效的 抗病毒药物 药物对于降低疾病严重程度和限制病毒 抗病毒药物 仍然至关重要。本研究评估了泰国药草 Clinacanthus siamensis 对抗 DENV 感染的 抗病毒药物 活性。使用体外 DENV 感染测定评估 C. siamensis 的乙醇提取物,并显示出显着的 抗病毒药物 活性,IC50 值为 19.32 μg/mL。使用添加时间实验在病毒生命周期的多个阶段评估提取物的抑制机制,包括预治疗、共治疗和感染后条件,其中病毒分别在病毒进入之前、期间和之后接触提取物。治疗 前条件表现出最高水平的抑制,提取物在浓度为 15.625、31.25 和 62.5 μg/mL 时,将病毒蛋白水平分别降低至 92.79 ± 7.74%、60.30 ± 9.79% 和 12.52 ± 10.18%。这些发现表明,提取物主要在感染的早期阶段发挥其 抗病毒药物 活性。这一观察结果得到了病毒结合测定的进一步支持,病毒结合测定表明,用提取物预处理病毒颗粒会损害其随后与 宿主 细胞结合的能力,这表明对病毒颗粒的直接影响可能有助于降低病毒感染性。此外,使用 LC-MS/MS 分析对提取物的生物活性成分进行了表征,确定了两种具有报道的 抗病毒药物 活性的化合物,包括异阿魏酸和木犀草素,这可能有助于观察到的抗 DENV 作用。这些研究结果表明,暹罗念珠菌通过降低感染早期的病毒感染性而具有有效的抗登革热病毒活性,并强调了暹罗念珠菌作为一种负担得起的针对登革热病毒感染的治疗候选药物的未来发展潜力。

analysis_zh.main_results: 治疗 前条件表现出最高水平的抑制,提取物在浓度为 15.625、31.25 和 62.5 μg/mL 时,将病毒蛋白水平分别降低至 92.79 ± 7.74%、60.30 ± 9.79% 和 12.52 ± 10.18%。该提取物表现出显着的 抗病毒药物 活性,IC50 值为 19.32 μg/mL。这一观察结果得到了病毒结合测定的进一步支持,病毒结合测定表明,用提取物预处理病毒颗粒会损害其随后与 宿主 细胞结合的能力。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,提取物主要在感染的早期阶段发挥其 抗病毒药物 活性。该研究强调了暹罗念珠菌作为一种经济实惠的登革热病毒感染治疗候选药物的未来发展潜力。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,暹罗念珠菌通过在感染早期降低病毒感染性而具有有效的抗 DENV 活性,并强调了念珠菌的潜力。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告该研究的局限性。

title: Evolutionary History and Genetic Diversity of the Four Dengue Virus Serotypes in Mexico from 1980 to 2021
abstract: Dengue is the most significant arboviral disease worldwide and is caused by dengue virus (DENV), which comprises four antigenically distinct serotypes (DENV-1–4) further classified into multiple genotypes and lineages. Mexico is a hyperendemic region where the co-circulation of all four serotypes contributes to recurrent epidemic outbreaks. This study aimed to characterize the evolutionary dynamics, genetic diversity, and geographic distribution of DENV in Mexico. Sequences representing the four serotypes were retrieved from GenBank and analyzed using phylogenetic and population genetic approaches to identify circulating genotypes and lineages, lineage replacement patterns, and genetic differentiation. Multiple DENV lineages were found to have circulated in Mexico over time, with evidence of repeated introductions, persistence, and lineage replacement. The geographic distribution of the analyzed sequences suggests an important role for the southeastern and Gulf–Caribbean region, particularly Tabasco, Yucatán, Veracruz, and Quintana Roo, in the introduction and subsequent dispersal of DENV toward central, Pacific, and northern Mexico. These findings highlight the dynamic evolutionary history of DENV in Mexico and support the integration of systematic genomic surveillance with epidemiological monitoring to improve the detection of changes in circulating viral lineages and strengthen regional dengue preparedness and control strategies.

elements_zh.methods: 从 GenBank 检索代表四种血清型的序列,并使用系统发育和群体遗传学方法进行分析,以确定循环基因型和谱系、谱系替换模式和遗传分化。
elements_zh.main_results: 人们发现,随着时间的推移,多个登革热病毒谱系在墨西哥传播,有反复引入、持续存在和谱系更替的证据。分析序列的地理分布表明,东南部和海湾加勒比地区,特别是塔巴斯科州、尤卡坦州、韦拉克鲁斯州和金塔纳罗奥州,在登革热病毒向墨西哥​​中部、太平洋和北部的引入和随后扩散中发挥着重要作用。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现突出了墨西哥登革热病毒的动态进化历史,并支持将系统性 基因组监测 与流行病学监测相结合,以改进对循环病毒谱系变化的检测,并加强区域登革热防范和控制策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,需要持续的 监测 和控制策略来解决墨西哥 DENV 循环的动态性质。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到对 GenBank 中可用序列的依赖以及可能丢失数据的限制。然而,由于对多个 DENV 谱系的综合分析,这些发现被认为具有很高的证据强度。

abstract_zh: 登革热是世界上最重要的虫媒病毒疾病,由 登革病毒 (DENV) 引起,其中包括四种抗原不同的血清型 (DENV-1–4),进一步分为多个基因型和谱系。墨西哥是一个高流行地区,所有四种血清型的共同循环导致 暴发 疫情反复流行。本研究旨在描述墨西哥 DENV 的进化动态、遗传多样性和地理分布。从 GenBank 检索代表四种血清型的序列,并使用系统发育和群体遗传学方法进行分析,以确定循环基因型和谱系、谱系替换模式和遗传分化。人们发现,随着时间的推移,多个登革热病毒谱系在墨西哥传播,有反复引入、持续存在和谱系更替的证据。分析序列的地理分布表明,东南部和海湾加勒比地区,特别是塔巴斯科州、尤卡坦州、韦拉克鲁斯州和金塔纳罗奥州,在登革热病毒向墨西哥​​中部、太平洋和北部的引入和随后扩散中发挥着重要作用。这些发现突出了墨西哥登革热病毒的动态进化历史,并支持将系统性 基因组监测 与流行病学监测相结合,以改进对循环病毒谱系变化的检测,并加强区域登革热防范和控制策略。

analysis_zh.methods: 从 GenBank 检索代表四种血清型的序列,并使用系统发育和群体遗传学方法进行分析,以确定循环基因型和谱系、谱系替换模式和遗传分化。
analysis_zh.main_results: 人们发现,随着时间的推移,多个登革热病毒谱系在墨西哥传播,有反复引入、持续存在和谱系更替的证据。分析序列的地理分布表明,东南部和海湾加勒比地区,特别是塔巴斯科州、尤卡坦州、韦拉克鲁斯州和金塔纳罗奥州,在登革热病毒向墨西哥​​中部、太平洋和北部的引入和随后扩散中发挥着重要作用。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现突出了墨西哥登革热病毒的动态进化历史,并支持将系统性 基因组监测 与流行病学监测相结合,以改进对循环病毒谱系变化的检测,并加强区域登革热防范和控制策略。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,需要持续的 监测 和控制策略来解决墨西哥 DENV 循环的动态性质。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到对 GenBank 中可用序列的依赖以及可能丢失数据的限制。然而,由于对多个 DENV 谱系的综合分析,这些发现被认为具有很高的证据强度。

title: Effect of Carica papaya Leaf Extract on Platelet Count in Dengue-Induced Thrombocytopenia: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
abstract: Dengue fever remains a prime public health trouble in tropical regions and is regularly related to thrombocytopenia. Carica papaya leaf extract (CPLE) has been broadly used as a conventional medicine to increase platelet counts in dengue sufferers. Numerous studies have analyzed the ability of Carica papaya leaves, which have verified effective as a therapy for thrombocytopenia. This systematic overview changed into performed according with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) Guidelines. The Cochrane Risk of Bias tool (RoB 2.0) and the ROBINS-I tool (Risk of Bias in Non-randomized Studies of Interventions) have been used to evaluate bias, and Rstudio became used for statistical analysis. Carica papaya leaf extract confirmed a significant increase in platelet count compared to the control (SMD = 0.40; 95% CI: 0.18–0.63; p = 0.0003). Subgroup analysis by way of day confirmed that the impact was no longer extensive on days 2 and 4, however giant on days 3 (SMD = 0.46; 95% CI: 0.04–0.87) and 5 (SMD = 0.63; 95% CI: 0.14–1.13), without a significant differences among the assessment times. Inside the adult populace (29 studies; n = 4,133), the intervention had a sizable effect (SMD = 0.52; 95% CI: 0.31–0.73; p < 0.0001) with an increasing effect from day 3 to 5. Within the pediatric population (7 research; n = 1,260), the intervention impact numerous over time, with a non-sizable effect on day 2, a large effect on day 3 (SMD = 0.54; 95% CI: 0.31–0.77), and day 5 (SMD = 1.21; 95% CI: 0.96–1.45), and a considerable difference among evaluation days (p < 0.0001). Carica papaya leaf extract adjunctive therapy effectively increases platelets in dengue patients with thrombocytopenia in the adult population, but not significantly in children.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 登革热 仍然是热带地区主要的公共卫生问题,并且通常与血小板减少症有关。该综述重点关注番木瓜叶提取物 (CPLE) 对登革热引起的血小板减少症中血小板计数的影响。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本系统概述是根据系统评价和荟萃分析的首选报告项目 (PRISMA) 指南进行的。使用Cochrane偏倚风险工具(RoB 2.0)和ROBINS-I工具(非随机干预研究中的偏倚风险)评估偏倚,并使用Rstudio进行统计分析。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 大量研究分析了番木瓜叶的功效,证实番木瓜叶可有效治疗血小板减少症。与对照相比,番木瓜叶提取物证实血小板计数显着增加(SMD = 0.40;95% CI:0.18–0.63;p = 0.0003)。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 按日进行的亚组分析证实,第 2 天和第 4 天的影响并不广泛,但在第 3 天(SMD = 0.46;95% CI:0.04–0.87)和第 5 天(SMD = 0.63;95% CI:0.14–1.13)显着,评估时间之间没有显着差异。在成年人群中(29 项研究;n = 4,133),干预具有显着效果(SMD = 0.52;95% CI:0.31–0.73;p < 0.0001),并且从第 3 天到第 5 天效果逐渐增强。在儿科人群中(7 项研究;n = 1,260),干预效果随时间变化,第 2 天效果不显着,第 1 天效果显着。第 3 天(SMD = 0.54;95% CI:0.31–0.77)和第 5 天(SMD = 1.21;95% CI:0.96–1.45),并且评估日之间存在显着差异(p < 0.0001)。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 番木瓜叶提取物辅助治疗可有效增加成人血小板减少症登革热患者的血小板,但在儿童中效果不显着。

title: Discordant RT-PCR Detection of Imported DENV-1 Infection: Diagnostic Challenges and Clinical Implications
abstract: Background and Objectives: Dengue virus (DENV) diagnosis during the acute phase relies mainly on nucleic-acid amplification tests, whose sensitivity can be affected by viral sequence variation, specimen timing, and viral load. Case Presentation: We describe a 30-year-old woman who returned to Italy from Indonesia with acute fever, headache, myalgia, retro-orbital pain, presyncope, and vomiting. Initial molecular and serological tests for DENV were negative. Because clinical suspicion remained high, RT-PCR was repeated the following day using a commercial assay targeting a different genomic region. The second assay was positive, whereas the first remained negative; repeat serology later demonstrated DENV IgM and IgG seroconversion. Sequence-independent amplification followed by Illumina sequencing yielded a near-complete DENV-1 genome. Nextclade placed the sequence within lineage 1I_K.3 among predominantly Asian strains. Because the oligonucleotide sequences of the negative commercial assay are proprietary, a specific primer/probe mismatch could not be demonstrated. Nevertheless, repeated assay discordance in the presence of sequence-confirmed viremia supports target-dependent loss of analytical sensitivity. Conclusions: This observation emphasizes the need to interpret negative DENV RT-PCR results in relation to illness timing and epidemiological context and, when suspicion persists, to use complementary or orthogonal diagnostic approaches.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the diagnostic challenges of dengue virus (DENV) detection during the acute phase, particularly the variability in sensitivity of nucleic-acid amplification tests.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A 30-year-old woman returning to Italy from Indonesia with symptoms of acute fever and headache was the case study. The study involved molecular and serological tests for DENV.
analysis.methods: RT-PCR was performed twice using different commercial assays targeting different genomic regions. Sequence-independent amplification followed by Illumina sequencing was used to confirm the DENV-1 genome.
analysis.main_results: The first RT-PCR assay was negative, but the second was positive. Repeat serology confirmed DENV IgM and IgG seroconversion. The sequence was placed within lineage 1I_K.3 among predominantly Asian strains.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The discordant results highlight the need to interpret negative DENV RT-PCR results in relation to illness timing and epidemiological context, and to use complementary or orthogonal diagnostic approaches when suspicion persists.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings emphasize the importance of considering the timing of specimen collection and the use of multiple diagnostic methods to improve the accuracy of DENV diagnosis.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study design limitations include the use of proprietary commercial assays, which could not be directly compared for mismatches. The evidence strength is moderate due to the small sample size and the focus on a single case.

analysis.summary_en: This study describes a case where initial RT-PCR tests for DENV-1 were negative but a second test was positive, highlighting the need for careful interpretation of negative results and the use of multiple diagnostic methods.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the diagnostic challenges of dengue virus (DENV) detection during the acute phase, particularly the variability in sensitivity of nucleic-acid amplification tests.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A 30-year-old woman returning to Italy from Indonesia with symptoms of acute fever and headache was the case study. The study involved molecular and serological tests for DENV.
analysis_en.methods: RT-PCR was performed twice using different commercial assays targeting different genomic regions. Sequence-independent amplification followed by Illumina sequencing was used to confirm the DENV-1 genome.
analysis_en.main_results: The first RT-PCR assay was negative, but the second was positive. Repeat serology confirmed DENV IgM and IgG seroconversion. The sequence was placed within lineage 1I_K.3 among predominantly Asian strains.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The discordant results highlight the need to interpret negative DENV RT-PCR results in relation to illness timing and epidemiological context, and to use complementary or orthogonal diagnostic approaches when suspicion persists.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings emphasize the importance of considering the timing of specimen collection and the use of multiple diagnostic methods to improve the accuracy of DENV diagnosis.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study design limitations include the use of proprietary commercial assays, which could not be directly compared for mismatches. The evidence strength is moderate due to the small sample size and the focus on a single case.

title_zh: 输入性 DENV-1 感染的 RT-PCR 检测不一致:诊断挑战和临床意义
source_body_en: Background and Objectives: Dengue virus (DENV) diagnosis during the acute phase relies mainly on nucleic-acid amplification tests, whose sensitivity can be affected by viral sequence variation, specimen timing, and viral load. Case Presentation: We describe a 30-year-old woman who returned to Italy from Indonesia with acute fever, headache, myalgia, retro-orbital pain, presyncope, and vomiting. Initial molecular and serological tests for DENV were negative. Because clinical suspicion remained high, RT-PCR was repeated the following day using a commercial assay targeting a different genomic region. The second assay was positive, whereas the first remained negative; repeat serology later demonstrated DENV IgM and IgG seroconversion. Sequence-independent amplification followed by Illumina sequencing yielded a near-complete DENV-1 genome. Nextclade placed the sequence within lineage 1I_K.3 among predominantly Asian strains. Because the oligonucleotide sequences of the negative commercial assay are proprietary, a specific primer/probe mismatch could not be demonstrated. Nevertheless, repeated assay discordance in the presence of sequence-confirmed viremia supports target-dependent loss of analytical sensitivity. Conclusions: This observation emphasizes the need to interpret negative DENV RT-PCR results in relation to illness timing and epidemiological context and, when suspicion persists, to use complementary or orthogonal diagnostic approaches.
abstract_zh: 背景和目的:登革病毒 (DENV) 急性期的诊断主要依靠核酸扩增检测,其敏感性可能受到病毒序列变异、标本时间和病毒载量的影响。病例介绍:我们描述了一名 30 岁女性,她从印度尼西亚返回意大利,出现急性发烧、头痛、肌痛、眼眶后疼痛、先兆晕厥和呕吐。DENV 的初步分子和血清学检测结果呈阴性。由于临床怀疑仍然很高,因此第二天使用针对不同基因组区域的商业测定法重复了 RT-PCR。第二次检测呈阳性,而第一次检测仍呈阴性;重复 血清学 后来证明了 DENV IgM 和 IgG 血清转换。独立于序列的扩增和 Illumina 测序产生了近乎完整的 DENV-1 基因组。Nextclade 将序列置于主要为亚洲菌株的谱系 1I_K.3 内。由于阴性商业检测的寡核苷酸序列是专有的,因此无法证明特定的引物/探针不匹配。然而,在序列确认的病毒血症存在的情况下重复测定的不一致支持了分析灵敏度的靶标依赖性损失。结论:这一观察强调需要根据发病时间和流行病学背景来解释阴性 DENV RT-PCR 结果,并且当怀疑持续存在时,需要使用补充或正交诊断方法。

title: Serum Cortisol and Lipid Profile as Predictors of Dengue Severity in Children: A Prospective Observational Study
abstract: Introduction: Early prediction of severe dengue in children continues to be difficult, even with World Health Organisation (WHO) warning signs. Alterations in stress hormones and lipid metabolism have been associated with dengue severity; however, prospective paediatric data are limited. Serum cortisol and lipid profile are routinely available laboratory parameters and may provide additional information regarding disease severity. Aim: To evaluate the significance of serum cortisol and lipid profile in forecasting the advancement to severe dengue in children. Materials and Methods: This prospective observational study was conducted in the Department of Paediatrics, SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre, Kattankulathur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, over two years (July 2024-July 2026). A total of 90 dengue NS1 or IgM ELISA-positive children aged between 0-14 years with warning signs and presenting between days 3 and 7 of illness were enrolled after informed consent. Serum cortisol and fasting lipid profile were measured at enrolment, and the day of illness at sampling was recorded. Children were classified according to subsequent progression to severe dengue. Categorical variables were compared using the Chisquare test and continuous variables using the independentsamples t-test; p-value <0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results: In the present study, 15 out of 90 (16.67%) children progressed to severe dengue. Boys constituted 57/90 (63.33%) of the cohort, and the largest age group was 1-5 years (32/90; 35.56%). Fluid accumulation, mucosal bleeding, lethargy, and significant liver enlargement were significantly associated with progression to severe dengue. Severe dengue was also associated with higher total leucocyte count and serum urea, lower serum sodium and bicarbonate, and prolonged prothrombin time. Mean serum cortisol was higher in children who progressed to severe dengue than in those who did not (18.74±6.14 vs 15.46±4.48 μg/dL; p-value =0.017). Mean triglyceride levels were also higher (220.07±141.71 vs 162.97±62.69 mg/dL; p-value =0.014), whereas mean total cholesterol levels were lower (99.67±23.70 vs 122.01±26.71 mg/dL; p-value =0.003). Very Low-Density Lipoprotein (VLDL), Low-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol (LDL-C), and High-Density Lipoprotein (HDL) levels did not differ significantly between groups. Conclusion: High levels of cortisol and triglycerides with low levels of total cholesterol at the time of admission are strongly linked to the development of severe dengue.

title_zh: 儿童登革热严重程度的预测:血清皮质醇和脂质谱作为预测因子的前瞻性观察性研究
source_body_en: Introduction: Early prediction of severe dengue in children continues to be difficult, even with World Health Organisation (WHO) warning signs. Alterations in stress hormones and lipid metabolism have been associated with dengue severity; however, prospective paediatric data are limited. Serum cortisol and lipid profile are routinely available laboratory parameters and may provide additional information regarding disease severity. Aim: To evaluate the significance of serum cortisol and lipid profile in forecasting the advancement to severe dengue in children. Materials and Methods: This prospective observational study was conducted in the Department of Paediatrics, SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre, Kattankulathur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, over two years (July 2024-July 2026). A total of 90 dengue NS1 or IgM ELISA-positive children aged between 0-14 years with warning signs and presenting between days 3 and 7 of illness were enrolled after informed consent. Serum cortisol and fasting lipid profile were measured at enrolment, and the day of illness at sampling was recorded. Children were classified according to subsequent progression to severe dengue. Categorical variables were compared using the Chisquare test and continuous variables using the independentsamples t-test; p-value <0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results: In the present study, 15 out of 90 (16.67%) children progressed to severe dengue. Boys constituted 57/90 (63.33%) of the cohort, and the largest age group was 1-5 years (32/90; 35.56%). Fluid accumulation, mucosal bleeding, lethargy, and significant liver enlargement were significantly associated with progression to severe dengue. Severe dengue was also associated with higher total leucocyte count and serum urea, lower serum sodium and bicarbonate, and prolonged prothrombin time. Mean serum cortisol was higher in children who progressed to severe dengue than in those who did not (18.74±6.14 vs 15.46±4.48 μg/dL; p-value =0.017). Mean triglyceride levels were also higher (220.07±141.71 vs 162.97±62.69 mg/dL; p-value =0.014), whereas mean total cholesterol levels were lower (99.67±23.70 vs 122.01±26.71 mg/dL; p-value =0.003). Very Low-Density Lipoprotein (VLDL), Low-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol (LDL-C), and High-Density Lipoprotein (HDL) levels did not differ significantly between groups. Conclusion: High levels of cortisol and triglycerides with low levels of total cholesterol at the time of admission are strongly linked to the development of severe dengue.
abstract_zh: 引言:即使有世界卫生组织(WHO)的警告信号,儿童登革热严重程度的早期预测仍然困难。压力激素和脂质代谢的变化与登革热严重程度有关,但前瞻性儿科数据有限。血清皮质醇和脂质谱是常规的实验室参数,可能提供有关疾病严重程度的额外信息。目的:评估血清皮质醇和脂质谱在预测儿童发展为登革热严重程度中的意义。材料与方法:本前瞻性观察性研究在印度泰米尔纳德邦金奈卡坦库拉特的SRM医学院医院和研究中心儿科部门进行,为期两年(2024年7月至2026年7月)。在获得知情同意后,共纳入了90名登革热NS1或IgM ELISA阳性、年龄在0-14岁之间、出现警告信号且在发病第3至第7天就诊的儿童。在入组时测量了血清皮质醇和空腹脂质谱,并记录了采样时的发病天数。根据后续发展为登革热严重程度对儿童进行分类。分类变量采用卡方检验,连续变量采用独立样本t检验;p值<0.05被认为具有统计学意义。结果:在本研究中,90名儿童中有15名(16.67%)发展为登革热严重程度。发展为登革热严重程度的儿童中,男孩占57/90(63.33%),最大年龄组为1-5岁(32/90;35.56%)。液体积聚、黏膜出血、嗜睡和显著肝脏肿大与发展为登革热严重程度显著相关。登革热严重程度还与较高的总白细胞计数和血清尿素、较低的血清钠和碳酸氢盐水平以及延长的凝血酶原时间有关。发展为登革热严重程度的儿童其血清皮质醇水平平均较高(18.74±6.14 vs 15.46±4.48 μg/dL;p值=0.017)。甘油三酯水平也较高(220.07±141.71 vs 162.97±62.69 mg/dL;p值=0.014),而总胆固醇水平较低(99.67±23.70 vs 122.01±26.71 mg/dL;p值=0.003)。极低密度脂蛋白(VLDL)、低密度脂蛋白胆固醇(LDL-C)和高密度脂蛋白(HDL)水平在两组之间没有显著差异。结论:入院时皮质醇和甘油三酯水平高而总胆固醇水平低,与登革热严重程度的发展有强烈关联。
