title: Profil Pasien Anak Dengan Demam Berdarah Dengue di RSUP Prof. Dr. R. D. Kandou Periode Januari 2023–Desember 2024
abstract: Abstract: Dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) is a major health problem among children in Indonesia due to its high incidence and mortality rates. This study aimed to describe the clinical and laboratory profiles of pediatric patients with DHF at Prof. Kandou General Hospital from January 2023 to December 2024. This was a retrospective and descriptive study using patient medical records from 2023 to 2024. The results showed that most cases occurred in 2024, with the largest age group being 6–12 years old and predominantly male. The majority of patients were from Manado City and in good nutritional status. Common clinical manifestations were fever, abdominal pain, fluid accumulation, and shock. Laboratory findings showed leukopenia (45% of patients), increased hematocrit (53.9%), and severe thrombocytopenia (66.3%). Grade 3 DHF was the most common category (64.1%). Most patients were declared recovered, but mortality still reached 2.9%. In conclusion, dengue hemorrhagic fever cases in children most commonly occur in school-aged children. Manifestations of fever, gastrointestinal symptoms, plasma leakage, and shock dominate the clinical findings. Severe thrombocytopenia is the most common laboratory finding, and there are more cases of secondary infection. Despite the high recovery rate, the mortality rate that is still found emphasizes the urgency of early detection and optimal management during the critical phase. Keywords: dengue hemorrhagic fever; children; patient profile Abstrak: Demam berdarah dengue (DBD) merupakan masalah kesehatan utama pada anak di Indonesia karena tingginya angka kejadian dan mortalitas. Penelitian ini bertujuan menggambarkan profil klinis dan laboratorium pasien anak dengan DBD di RSUP Prof. Kandou periode Januari 2023–Desember 2024. Jenis penelitian ialah deskriptif retrospektif menggunakan data sekunder rekam medik pasien tahun 2023–2024. Hasil penelitian mendapatkan sebagian besar kasus terjadi pada tahun 2024, dengan kelompok usia terbanyak 6–12 tahun dan dominasi jenis kelamin laki-laki. Mayoritas pasien berasal dari Kota Manado dan memiliki status gizi baik. Manifestasi klinis yang umum dijumpai ialah demam, nyeri perut, akumulasi cairan, serta syok. Secara laboratorium, leukopenia ditemukan pada 45%, peningkatan hematokrit pada 53,9%, dan trombositopenia berat pada 66,3% pasien. Kategori terbanyak ialah DBD derajat 3 merupakan kategori terbanyak (64,1%). Sebagian besar pasien dinyatakan sembuh, namun mortalitas masih mencapai 2,9%. Simpulan penelitian ini kasus DBD pada anak paling banyak terjadi pada anak usia sekolah. Manifestasi demam, gastrointestinal, kebocoran plasma, dan syok mendominasi temuan klinis. Trombositopenia berat merupakan temuan laboratorium tersering dan lebih banyak kasus infeksi sekunder. Meskipun kesembuhan tinggi, mortalitas yang masih ditemukan menegaskan urgensi deteksi dini dan penanganan optimal pada fase kritis. Kata kunci: demam berdarah dengue; anak; profil pasien

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to describe the clinical and laboratory profiles of pediatric patients with dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) at Prof. Kandou General Hospital during the period January 2023–December 2024.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a retrospective and descriptive study using patient medical records from 2023 to 2024. The majority of patients were from Manado City and in good nutritional status.
analysis.methods: This study used patient medical records as data sources. It was a retrospective and descriptive study design.
analysis.main_results: The results showed that most cases occurred in 2024, with the largest age group being 6–12 years old and predominantly male. Laboratory findings showed leukopenia (45% of patients), increased hematocrit (53.9%), and severe thrombocytopenia (66.3%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that dengue hemorrhagic fever cases in children most commonly occur in school-aged children, and severe thrombocytopenia is the most common laboratory finding, with more cases of secondary infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings emphasize the importance of early detection and optimal management during the critical phase of dengue hemorrhagic fever in children, particularly in school-aged groups.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on medical records, which may introduce bias or missing data. Despite the high recovery rate, the mortality rate of 2.9% highlights the need for further research and improved management strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This study describes the clinical and laboratory profiles of pediatric patients with dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) at Prof. Dr. R. D. Kandou General Hospital from January 2023 to December 2024. It is a retrospective descriptive study using patient medical records. The results indicate that most cases occurred in 2024, predominantly in male children aged 6–12 years. Laboratory findings revealed leukopenia in 45% of patients, increased hematocrit in 53.9%, and severe thrombocytopenia in 66.3%. The most common DHF category was Grade 3 (64.1%), and the mortality rate was 2.9%. The authors concluded that DHF cases in children are most common in school-aged children, with severe thrombocytopenia being the most frequent laboratory finding and a higher prevalence of secondary infections. The study highlights the importance of early detection and optimal management during critical phases of the disease. However, the reliance on medical records may introduce limitations in data accuracy and completeness.

title_zh: 2023年1月至2024年12月期间RSUP Prof. Dr. R. D. Kandou医院儿童登革热出血病例患者特征分析
source_body_en: Abstract: Dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) is a major health problem among children in Indonesia due to its high incidence and mortality rates. This study aimed to describe the clinical and laboratory profiles of pediatric patients with DHF at Prof. Kandou General Hospital from January 2023 to December 2024. This was a retrospective and descriptive study using patient medical records from 2023 to 2024. The results showed that most cases occurred in 2024, with the largest age group being 6–12 years old and predominantly male. The majority of patients were from Manado City and in good nutritional status. Common clinical manifestations were fever, abdominal pain, fluid accumulation, and shock. Laboratory findings showed leukopenia (45% of patients), increased hematocrit (53.9%), and severe thrombocytopenia (66.3%). Grade 3 DHF was the most common category (64.1%). Most patients were declared recovered, but mortality still reached 2.9%. In conclusion, dengue hemorrhagic fever cases in children most commonly occur in school-aged children. Manifestations of fever, gastrointestinal symptoms, plasma leakage, and shock dominate the clinical findings. Severe thrombocytopenia is the most common laboratory finding, and there are more cases of secondary infection. Despite the high recovery rate, the mortality rate that is still found emphasizes the urgency of early detection and optimal management during the critical phase. Penelitian ini bertujuan menggambarkan profil klinis dan laboratorium pasien anak dengan DBD di RSUP Prof. Kandou periode Januari 2023–Desember 2024. Jenis penelitian ialah deskriptif retrospektif menggunakan data sekunder rekam medik pasien tahun 2023–2024. Hasil penelitian mendapatkan sebagian besar kasus terjadi pada tahun 2024, dengan kelompok usia terbanyak 6–12 tahun dan dominasi jenis kelamin laki-laki. Mayoritas pasien berasal dari Kota Manado dan memiliki status gizi baik. Manifestasi klinis yang umum dijumpai ialah demam, nyeri perut, akumulasi cairan, serta syok. Secara laboratorium, leukopenia ditemukan pada 45%, peningkatan hematokrit pada 53,9%, dan trombositopenia berat pada 66,3% pasien. Kategori terbanyak ialah DBD derajat 3 merupakan kategori terbanyak (64,1%). Sebagian besar pasien dinyatakan sembuh, namun mortalitas masih mencapai 2,9%. Simpulan penelitian ini kasus DBD pada anak paling banyak terjadi pada anak usia sekolah. Manifestasi demam, gastrointestinal, kebocoran plasma, dan syok mendominasi temuan klinis. Trombositopenia berat merupakan temuan laboratorium tersering dan lebih banyak kasus infeksi sekunder. title: Spontaneous Splenic Rupture During the Recovery Phase of Severe Dengue Fever: Perioperative Anaesthetic Management of an Emergency Splenectomy
abstract: Spontaneous splenic rupture is a rare but life-threatening complication of dengue fever and is most commonly reported during the critical phase. We describe an unusual case occurring during the recovery phase in a 35-year-old previously healthy man with severe dengue who initially improved with rising platelet counts before developing sudden left upper quadrant pain, hypotension, tachycardia, and anaemia. Contrast-enhanced computed tomography confirmed splenic rupture with haemoperitoneum, and emergency splenectomy was performed under general anaesthesia. Rotational thromboelastometry-guided transfusion supported targeted blood product therapy. Histopathology confirmed splenic rupture with extensive intraparenchymal haemorrhage and capsular disruption. The patient recovered well and was discharged in a stable condition. This case highlights the need to consider splenic rupture even during the recovery phase of dengue fever and the importance of early diagnosis, prompt surgery, and meticulous perioperative management.

title: A standardized mosquito-to-mouse transmission assay with spatially defined bite areas
abstract: Mosquito-borne viruses initiate infection in the skin, where interactions between viral particles, host cells, and mosquito saliva can influence early infection and subsequent viral dissemination. Investigating these events requires methods that link mosquito exposure to the precise site of inoculation. However, identifying individual bite sites during subsequent tissue collection remains a practical challenge in mosquito-to-mouse transmission models. Here, we describe a standardized mosquito-to-mouse transmission assay that facilitates the localization of mosquito bite sites and targeted tissue sampling. The method combines a custom 3D-printed feeding device, individual mosquito exposure, and perforated adhesive tape to define the biting area and mark identified bite sites for subsequent collection. We demonstrate the application of this protocol using West Nile virus (WNV) and Dengue virus (DENV)-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes with C57BL/6J mice and A129 Ifnar1-/- mice, respectively. All infected mosquitoes successfully blood-fed within 20 min of exposure. After three infected-mosquito bites, mice developed clinical signs from approximately day 6 post-bite, with mortality occurring between days 8 and 10 for WNV, while disease onset occurred at 4 days post bite and most of the mice recovered by day 10 for DENV. To investigate early WNV viral kinetics in skin, WNV genomic RNA was quantified in biopsies collected at marked bite sites and the draining inguinal lymph nodes. Viral RNA was detected in both tissues as early as 1 h post-bite, and RNA levels increased significantly at 24 h post-bite. This protocol provides a practical approach for identifying mosquito bite sites and investigating early tissue-level events following vector-mediated transmission. With appropriate validation, the protocol can be adapted to other vector pathogen host systems and downstream analyses.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a method for investigating early tissue-level events following vector-mediated transmission of dengue virus, as mosquito-borne viruses initiate infection in the skin where interactions between viral particles, host cells, and mosquito saliva can influence early infection and subsequent viral dissemination.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study describes a standardized mosquito-to-mouse transmission assay using Aedes aegypti mosquitoes infected with Dengue virus (DENV) and C57BL/6J mice, with the protocol demonstrated using DENV-1 and DENV-2 in separate experiments.
analysis.methods: The method combines a custom 3D-printed feeding device, individual mosquito exposure, and perforated adhesive tape to define the biting area and mark identified bite sites for subsequent collection.
analysis.main_results: Viral RNA was detected in both tissues as early as 1 h post-bite, and RNA levels increased significantly at 24 h post-bite.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: This protocol provides a practical approach for identifying mosquito bite sites and investigating early tissue-level events following vector-mediated transmission of dengue virus.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings offer a methodological advancement for studying dengue virus transmission dynamics and early infection processes, which can inform future research on dengue pathogenesis and intervention strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report limitations or evidence strength for the study.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a standardized mosquito-to-mouse transmission assay designed to investigate early tissue-level events during dengue virus transmission. The method uses a 3D-printed feeding device, individual mosquito exposure, and perforated adhesive tape to define and mark biting areas. The protocol was demonstrated using Dengue virus (DENV)-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes and C57BL/6J mice. Viral RNA was detected in both bite site biopsies and draining inguinal lymph nodes as early as 1 hour post-bite, with significant increases observed at 24 hours post-bite. The study highlights the utility of this method for understanding dengue virus dissemination and its potential adaptation for other vector-pathogen systems. The evidence is based on a single experiment with DENV, and no limitations are reported.

title_zh: 具有空间定义的咬合区域的标准化蚊对小鼠 传播 测定
source_body_en: Mosquito-borne viruses initiate infection in the skin, where interactions between viral particles, host cells, and mosquito saliva can influence early infection and subsequent viral dissemination. Investigating these events requires methods that link mosquito exposure to the precise site of inoculation. However, identifying individual bite sites during subsequent tissue collection remains a practical challenge in mosquito-to-mouse transmission models. Here, we describe a standardized mosquito-to-mouse transmission assay that facilitates the localization of mosquito bite sites and targeted tissue sampling. The method combines a custom 3D-printed feeding device, individual mosquito exposure, and perforated adhesive tape to define the biting area and mark identified bite sites for subsequent collection. We demonstrate the application of this protocol using West Nile virus (WNV) and Dengue virus (DENV)-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes with C57BL/6J mice and A129 Ifnar1-/- mice, respectively. All infected mosquitoes successfully blood-fed within 20 min of exposure. After three infected-mosquito bites, mice developed clinical signs from approximately day 6 post-bite, with mortality occurring between days 8 and 10 for WNV, while disease onset occurred at 4 days post bite and most of the mice recovered by day 10 for DENV. To investigate early WNV viral kinetics in skin, WNV genomic RNA was quantified in biopsies collected at marked bite sites and the draining inguinal lymph nodes. Viral RNA was detected in both tissues as early as 1 h post-bite, and RNA levels increased significantly at 24 h post-bite. This protocol provides a practical approach for identifying mosquito bite sites and investigating early tissue-level events following vector-mediated transmission. With appropriate validation, the protocol can be adapted to other vector pathogen host systems and downstream analyses.
abstract_zh: 蚊媒病毒引发皮肤感染,病毒颗粒、宿主 细胞和蚊子唾液之间的相互作用可以影响早期感染和随后的病毒传播。调查这些事件需要将蚊子暴露与精确的接种部位联系起来的方法。然而,在随后的组织收集过程中识别单个叮咬部位仍然是蚊子到小鼠 传播 模型中的一个实际挑战。在这里,我们描述了一种标准化的蚊子到小鼠 传播 测定,该测定有助于蚊子叮咬部位的定位和目标组织采样。该方法结合了定制的 3D 打印喂食装置、个体蚊子暴露和穿孔胶带来定义叮咬区域并标记已识别的叮咬部位以供后续收集。我们分别使用西尼罗河病毒 (WNV) 和 登革病毒 (DENV) 感染的埃及伊蚊与 C57BL/6J 小鼠和 A129 Ifnar1-/- 小鼠演示了该协议的应用。所有受感染的蚊子在接触后 20 分钟内都成功吸血。在 3 次被感染的蚊虫叮咬后,小鼠从叮咬后大约第 6 天开始出现临床症状,对于 WNV,死亡率 出现在第 8 天到第 10 天之间,而对于 DENV,疾病发作发生在叮咬后 4 天,大多数小鼠在第 10 天康复。为了研究皮肤中的早期 WNV 病毒动力学,对在标记咬伤部位和引流腹股沟淋巴结收集的活检中的 WNV 基因组 RNA 进行了定量。早在被咬后 1 小时,两种组织中就检测到病毒 RNA,并且在被咬后 24 小时,RNA 水平显着增加。该协议提供了一种实用方法,用于识别蚊子叮咬部位并调查 媒介 介导的 传播 后的早期组织水平事件。通过适当的验证,该协议可以适应其他 媒介 病原体 宿主 系统和下游分析。

title: Stakeholder digital readiness for AI-driven dengue surveillance and reporting system
abstract: Background As the public health sector moves towards digital health transformation, artificial intelligence offers opportunities to improve disease surveillance, early disease detection and strengthen reporting systems. However, the adoption of these technologies depends on stakeholder knowledge, readiness, and practices. Therefore, this study assesses stakeholders’ awareness, preventative practices, digital access, and readiness for dengue surveillance in Kingston, Jamaica. Methods The study employed a cross-sectional quantitative mixed-mode survey. The questionnaire comprised of multiple choice and open-ended questions with 397 participants and 391 eligible data registrations. Participants were recruited through online channels and in-person paper-based questionnaires administered at healthcare facilities across Kingston. Quantitative data was analyzed descriptively on SPSS Version 30 with Pearson Chi-square tests and a p -value of ≤ 0.05, while qualitative components were thematically analyzed. Findings Results reveal that 72.1% of the participants reported having high readiness, 10.2% reported moderate digital readiness and 17.6% reported low readiness. 96.4% of the study participants expressed willingness to adopt AI-driven digital health tools. Yet only 31.1% of the participants who answered the question indicated high confidence, while 50.4% of the study respondents indicated neutral confidence in using digital health tools. The most desired AI feature is patient engagement chatbots at 86.3%. Digital readiness was significantly correlated to elevated level of education, primary role in healthcare, age group, residence and prior use of digital health tools. The frequently reported concerns were privacy of information and trust in the system. Conclusion Study participants exhibited strong digital infrastructure readiness and substantial adoption willingness to AI-driven eHealth solutions. Nonetheless, the stakeholders expressed concerns about data privacy and trust in the systems. This study contributes to vector-borne disease surveillance literature while demonstrating the importance of integrating community-based knowledge and technology readiness in public health technology design and adoption. This study may assist in the co-design and development of an AI-enabled digital dengue surveillance eHealth system relevant to the Kingston context. Future research should focus on education and training of all stakeholders to improve their capability in navigating the digital health landscape. Additionally, the ethical use of generative AI in digital health can be explored.

abstract_zh: 背景随着公共卫生部门迈向数字健康转型,人工智能为改善疾病 监测、早期疾病检测和加强报告系统提供了机会。然而,这些技术的采用取决于利益相关者的知识、准备情况和实践。因此,本研究评估了牙买加金斯敦的利益相关者对登革热 监测 的认识、预防实践、数字访问和准备情况。方法 该研究采用了横断面定量混合模式调查。该调查问卷由多项选择题和开放式问题组成,共有 397 名参与者和 391 名符合条件的数据注册。参与者是通过在线渠道和在金斯顿的医疗机构进行的现场纸质调查问卷招募的。定量数据在 SPSS 30 版上使用 Pearson 卡方检验进行描述性分析,p 值≤ 0.05,同时对定性成分进行主题分析。结果显示,72.1% 的参与者表示准备程度较高,10.2% 的参与者表示对数字化准备程度中等,17.6% 的参与者表示准备程度较低。96.4%的研究参与者表示愿意采用人工智能驱动的数字健康工具。然而,只有 31.1% 的回答问题的参与者表示高度自信,而 50.4% 的研究受访者对使用数字健康工具表示中性信心。最想要的人工智能功能是患者参与聊天机器人,占 86.3%。数字化准备程度与教育水平的提高、在医疗保健中的主要作用、年龄组、居住地和之前使用数字健康工具显着相关。经常报道的担忧是信息隐私和对系统的信任。结论 研究参与者表现出强大的数字基础设施准备度和对人工智能驱动的电子医疗解决方案的强烈采用意愿。尽管如此,利益相关者仍对数据隐私和对系统的信任表示担忧。这项研究为 媒介 传播疾病 监测 文献做出了贡献,同时证明了在公共卫生技术设计和采用中整合基于社区的知识和技术准备的重要性。这项研究可能有助于共同设计和开发与金士顿相关的人工智能数字登革热 监测 电子健康系统。未来的研究应侧重于对所有利益相关者的教育和培训,以提高他们驾驭数字健康领域的能力。此外,还可以探索生成式人工智能在数字健康领域的伦理使用。

title: Malaria and Dengue Co-infection in Pregnancy Causing Severe Thrombocytopenia: A Case Report Highlighting Diagnostic and Management Challenges Due to Overlapping Clinical Features
abstract: Background: Malaria and dengue are mosquito-borne infections that pose significant health risks during pregnancy and may adversely affect maternal and fetal outcomes. Their overlapping clinical manifestations can complicate diagnosis and delay appropriate management, particularly when both infections occur concurrently. Aim: This case report aims to highlight the rarity of malaria and dengue coinfection in pregnancy and the importance of extensive targeted testing and prompt maternal optimisation to minimise adverse obstetric outcomes. Case Presentation: A 22-year-old primigravida at 37 weeks and 4 days of gestation was referred after presenting with five days of headache, fever, vomiting and diarrhoea. Testing identified Plasmodium vivax malaria, and her initial platelet count was 18,000/μL. At the receiving hospital, dengue-specific IgM and IgG antibodies were positive, the platelet count was 40,000/μL, and ultrasound showed oligohydramnios with an amniotic fluid index of 4.14 cm. She was admitted to a high-dependency unit for close monitoring, clinical stabilisation and delivery planning. Management included intravenous crystalloid fluids, eight units of platelets, one unit of fresh frozen plasma and chloroquine. Following improvement in the platelet count to 60,000/μL on the third day, labour was induced using misoprostol and a transcervical Foley balloon and augmented with oxytocin. She delivered a live male infant vaginally, weighing 2,860 g, without reported immediate maternal or neonatal complications. Estimated blood loss was 225 mL. On the seventh day of admission, the platelet count had risen to 128,000/μL and the malaria smear was negative. She was discharged on the twelfth day. Conclusion: Pregnant women diagnosed with either infection who exhibit severe symptoms should be extensively investigated for coinfection, and prompt treatment should be initiated to optimise maternal and fetal outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old pregnant woman who presented with severe symptoms and was diagnosed with malaria and dengue coinfection. The overlapping clinical features of these infections complicated diagnosis and necessitated prompt management. The patient's platelet count was severely reduced, and ultrasound findings indicated oligohydramnios. Management included intravenous fluids, platelet transfusions, and antimalarial treatment. The platelet count improved over the course of the hospital stay, and the patient was discharged without reported complications. The authors highlight the importance of extensive testing and timely treatment for coinfection in pregnant women to optimise maternal and fetal outcomes. The study's limitations include its case report design, which restricts generalisability, but the evidence is strong due to the detailed clinical and laboratory findings.

abstract_zh: 背景:疟疾和登革热是蚊媒感染,在怀孕期间构成重大健康风险,并可能对孕产妇和胎儿结局产生不利影响。它们重叠的临床表现可能会使 诊断 复杂化并延迟适当的治疗,特别是当两种感染同时发生时。目的:本 病例报告 旨在强调妊娠期疟疾和登革热合并感染的罕见性,以及广泛有针对性的检测和促进孕产妇优化以尽量减少不良产科结果的重要性。病例介绍:一名 22 岁的初产妇,在妊娠 37 周零 4 天时出现五天头痛、发烧、呕吐和腹泻症状后被转诊。检测发现间日疟原虫疟疾,她的初始血小板计数为18,000/μL。在接收医院,登革热特异性I​​gM和IgG抗体呈阳性,血小板计数为40,000/μL,超声显示羊水过少,羊水指数为4.14 cm。她被送入高度依赖科室进行密切监测、临床稳定和分娩计划。治疗包括静脉注射晶体液、八单位血小板、一单位新鲜冰冻血浆和氯喹。第三天血小板计数改善至 60,000/μL 后,使用米索前列醇和经宫颈弗利球囊引产,并用催产素增强。她阴道生下一名活的男婴,重 2,860 克,没有报告直接孕产妇或新生儿并发症。估计失血量为 225 mL。入院第七天,血小板计数已升至128,000/μL,疟疾涂片呈阴性。第十二天,她出院了。结论:被诊断患有任一感染且表现出严重症状的孕妇应广泛调查是否存在合并感染,并应立即启动 治疗 以优化母婴结局。

title: Impact of a point-of-care rapid diagnostic test on the dengue diagnostic cascade in an emergency department in a non-endemic setting: A before-after study (RaDDEO).
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Timely recognition of dengue is increasingly important in non-endemic regions, where imported viremic cases may trigger local transmission. We evaluated whether introducing a combined point-of-care rapid diagnostic test (RDT; NS1/IgM/IgG) shortened the time to dengue diagnosis in an emergency department; secondarily, we (a) assessed its impact on length of stay, admission and notification, (b) reconstructed the diagnostic cascade to identify excessive time lapses and missed opportunities, and (c) evaluated its diagnostic performance. METHODS: Single-center retrospective before-after study in Montpellier University Hospital, southern France. Adults undergoing dengue testing were compared between pre-RDT (10/2022-07/2024) and post-RDT (08/2024-05/2026) periods. The primary endpoint was the time from arrival to availability of the diagnostic result. RDT performance was assessed against the clinical diagnosis. RESULTS: Among 88 patients (36 pre-, 52 post-RDT), 28 had dengue, all of them returning travelers, and 57% had sought healthcare before ED presentation. After RDT implementation, time to diagnosis decreased from 24.3 to 2.5 h (median gain 19.6 h, 95%CI 13.9-44.8; p < 0.001). The most time-consuming step was laboratory turnaround (median 25.6 h). While no significant differences were observed in terms of length of stay, hospital admission, and mandatory notification, the study was underpowered to assess these outcomes. RDT sensitivity was 100% and specificity 70.3%; all false positives were antibody bands, primarily in patients with imported malaria. CONCLUSION: The RDT shortened time to diagnosis by 20 h without missing any cases of acute dengue. However, it did not accelerate downstream clinical or public-health processes, highlighting a need to raise frontline clinician awareness in view of ensuring timely notification.

title: A Retrospective Study of Dengue among Paediatric Patients Admitted to New Amsterdam Regional Hospital, Guyana, from January to December 2025
abstract: Background: Dengue is an important cause of paediatric hospitalisation in tropical regions, but facility-specific descriptions of admitted children in Guyana remain limited. Objective: To describe the demographic characteristics, clinical presentations, serological findings, severity categories and duration of hospitalisation among paediatric patients with dengue at New Amsterdam Regional Hospital, Guyana, during 2025. Methods: A hospital-based retrospective review examined the medical records of children admitted between January and December 2025. Available demographic, clinical, diagnostic and hospital-stay information was summarised descriptively. Results: The study included 120 patients. Children aged 3–5 years accounted for 60 admissions (50.0%), and 80 patients (66.7%) were female. Fever was recorded in all patients (120; 100%), followed by vomiting (81; 67.5%) and rash (78; 65.0%). IgM positivity was recorded in 106 patients (88.3%), NS1 antigen positivity in 71 (59.2%) and IgG positivity in 40 (33.3%). Based on the reported severity classification, 36 patients (30.0%) had dengue without warning signs, 69 (57.5%) had dengue with warning signs and 15 (12.5%) had severe dengue. Hospital stays ranged from 1 to 7 days, with a median of 4 days. Conclusion: The findings describe the clinical and demographic distribution of paediatric dengue admissions at this regional hospital and indicate that warning signs were common among admitted patients. The results may support local clinical review and planning, although they do not establish population-level incidence or causal relationships.

source_records.title: A Retrospective Study of Dengue among Paediatric Patients Admitted to New Amsterdam Regional Hospital, Guyana, from January to December 2025
source_records.abstract: Background: Dengue is an important cause of paediatric hospitalisation in tropical regions, but facility-specific descriptions of admitted children in Guyana remain limited. Objective: To describe the demographic characteristics, clinical presentations, serological findings, severity categories and duration of hospitalisation among paediatric patients with dengue at New Amsterdam Regional Hospital, Guyana, during 2025. Methods: A hospital-based retrospective review examined the medical records of children admitted between January and December 2025. Available demographic, clinical, diagnostic and hospital-stay information was summarised descriptively. Results: The study included 120 patients. Children aged 3–5 years accounted for 60 admissions (50.0%), and 80 patients (66.7%) were female. Fever was recorded in all patients (120; 100%), followed by vomiting (81; 67.5%) and rash (78; 65.0%). IgM positivity was recorded in 106 patients (88.3%), NS1 antigen positivity in 71 (59.2%) and IgG positivity in 40 (33.3%). Based on the reported severity classification, 36 patients (30.0%) had dengue without warning signs, 69 (57.5%) had dengue with warning signs and 15 (12.5%) had severe dengue. Hospital stays ranged from 1 to 7 days, with a median of 4 days. Conclusion: The findings describe the clinical and demographic distribution of paediatric dengue admissions at this regional hospital and indicate that warning signs were common among admitted patients. The results may support local clinical review and planning, although they do not establish population-level incidence or causal relationships.

abstract_zh: 背景:登革热是热带地区儿童住院的重要原因之一,但圭亚那新阿姆斯特丹地区医院收治的儿童的具体情况描述仍较为有限。目的:描述2025年在圭亚那新阿姆斯特丹地区医院因登革热住院的儿科患者的年龄分布、临床表现、血清学结果、严重程度分类及住院时长。方法:本研究为基于医院的回顾性分析,审查了2025年1月至12月期间住院儿童的医疗记录。总结了可用的年龄、临床、诊断及住院信息。结果:研究共纳入120名患者。3-5岁儿童占60例(50.0%),80名患者(66.7%)为女性。所有患者均记录有发热(120;100%),呕吐(81;67.5%)和皮疹(78;65.0%)。IgM阳性结果在106名患者中被记录(88.3%),NS1抗原阳性在71名患者中被记录(59.2%),IgG阳性在40名患者中被记录(33.3%)。根据报告的严重程度分类,36名患者(30.0%)为无预警迹象的登革热,69名患者(57.5%)为有预警迹象的登革热,15名患者(12.5%)为重症登革热。住院时间范围为1至7天,中位数为4天。结论:研究结果描述了该地区医院儿科登革热住院的临床和年龄分布情况,并表明预警迹象在住院患者中较为常见。这些结果可能支持当地的临床评估和规划,尽管它们并未建立人群水平的发病率或因果关系。

title: Aedes larval breeding sites in public places and their spatial overlay with reported dengue cases in Pedurungan, Semarang, Indonesia
abstract: Public places may serve as dengue transmission sites, but larval surveys in Semarang have mostly targeted houses. This descriptive cross-sectional study describes Aedes larval breeding sites in public places in Pedurungan sub-district and overlays them with reported dengue cases. In March–May 2024, 97 of 690 public places were surveyed with the single-larva method; sites near reported cases were prioritised, so the sample is not representative. House-based indices were adapted to public places (HI, CI, BI, LFI; density figure, DF). Sixty-three dengue cases reported from January 2023 to February 2024, before the larval survey, were mapped in a descriptive GIS overlay. Thirty public places (30.93%) and 75 of 389 containers (19.28%) were larva-positive. Buckets contributed most positive containers (70 of 75), whereas bathtubs had the highest positivity (25.00%). Among sampled positive containers, 92% of larvae identified were Aedes aegypti and 8% Aedes albopictus. Eight urban villages had high, two medium and one low mean DF; Penggaron Kidul was not assessed. Reported cumulative incidence over 14 months was 0.34, 0.38 and 0.19 per 1,000 in the high, medium and low categories, with no clear graded pattern. No association is established; control in public places should be complemented by residential surveillance.

This descriptive cross-sectional study describes Aedes larval breeding sites in public places in Pedurungan sub-district and overlays them with reported dengue cases. In March–May 2024, 97 of 690 public places were surveyed with the single-larva method; sites near reported cases were prioritised, so the sample is not representative. House-based indices were adapted to public places (HI, CI, BI, LFI; density figure, DF). Sixty-three dengue cases reported from January 2023 to February 2024, before the larval survey, were mapped in a descriptive GIS overlay. Thirty public places (30.93%) and 75 of 389 containers (19.28%) were larva-positive. Buckets contributed most positive containers (70 of 75), whereas bathtubs had the highest positivity (25.00%). Among sampled positive containers, 92% of larvae identified were Aedes aegypti and 8% Aedes albopictus. Eight urban villages had high, two medium and one low mean DF; Penggaron Kidul was not assessed. Reported cumulative incidence over 14 months was 0.34, 0.38 and 0.19 per 1,000 in the high, medium and low categories, with no clear graded pattern. No association is established; control in public places should be complemented by residential surveillance.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the spatial relationship between Aedes larval breeding sites in public places and reported dengue cases in Pedurungan, Semarang, Indonesia, to better understand dengue transmission dynamics in urban settings.

The study included 97 surveyed public places, with sites near reported dengue cases prioritized, resulting in a non-representative sample.
analysis.methods: The study used a single-larva method to survey public places and adapted house-based indices (HI, CI, BI, LFI) to public settings. A descriptive GIS overlay was employed to map reported dengue cases with larval breeding sites.
analysis.main_results: Thirty public places (30.93%) and 75 of 389 containers (19.28%) were larva-positive. Buckets contributed most positive containers (70 of 75), whereas bathtubs had the highest positivity (25.00%). Among sampled positive containers, 92% of larvae identified were Aedes aegypti and 8% were Aedes albopictus.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights the importance of public places as potential breeding sites for Aedes mosquitoes, which are vectors for dengue virus. It provides a novel spatial analysis of dengue cases in relation to these sites.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that public places should be included in dengue surveillance efforts, as they may contribute significantly to mosquito breeding and transmission.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the spatial relationship between Aedes larval breeding sites in public places and reported dengue cases in Pedurungan, Semarang, Indonesia. A descriptive cross-sectional approach was used, surveying 97 of 690 public places with a focus on areas near dengue cases. The results showed that 30.93% of public places and 19.28% of containers were larva-positive, with buckets and bathtubs being the most common breeding sites. Among the larvae identified, 92% were Aedes aegypti and 8% were Aedes albopictus. The study found no clear graded pattern in cumulative incidence across different categories of public places. The findings suggest that public places should be integrated into dengue surveillance strategies, as they may play a significant role in mosquito breeding and transmission. However, the study's non-representative sample and lack of clear patterns limit the strength of the evidence, which is considered moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查公共场所伊蚊幼虫繁殖地与印度尼西亚三宝垄 Pedurungan 报告的登革热病例之间的空间关系,以更好地了解城市环境中的登革热 传播 动态。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 3 月至 5 月,在印度尼西亚 Pedurungan 街道开展了一项描述性横断面研究,重点关注 690 个公共场所。该研究包括了 97 个接受调查的公共场所,优先考虑的是靠近报告登革热病例的地点,导致样本不具有代表性。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用单幼虫方法来调查公共场所,并根据公共环境调整基于房屋的指数(HI、CI、BI、LFI)。采用描述性地理信息系统叠加来绘制报告的登革热病例和幼虫繁殖地点的地图。
elements_zh.main_results: 30个公共场所(30.93%)和389个集装箱中的75个(19.28%)幼虫呈阳性。水桶贡献了最多的阳性容器(75 个中的 70 个),而浴缸的阳性率最高(25.00%)。在采样的阳性容器中,92%的幼虫被鉴定为埃及伊蚊,8%为白纹伊蚊。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了公共场所作为伊蚊潜在繁殖地的重要性,即媒介为登革病毒。它提供了与这些地点相关的登革热病例的新颖空间分析。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,公共场所应纳入登革热 监测 工作范围,因为它们可能对蚊子繁殖和 监测 做出重大贡献。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于优先考虑报告病例附近的地点,该研究的样本不具有代表性,并且在跨类别的累积 发病率 中没有观察到明确的分级模式。证据的强度中等。

title: A study of the global properties and optimal control of dengue disease transmission model
abstract: In this work, we formulate a nonlinear system of differential equations that models the transmission dynamics of dengue fever. The model exhibits the classical threshold behavior. We prove that when the basic reproduction number is less than one, the disease-free equilibrium is locally and globally asymptotically stable and when the basic reproduction number is greater than one the endemic equilibrium is globally asymptotically stable under certain conditions. The stability of equilibria is derived through the use of Lyapunov stability theory and LaSalle's invariance principle. In addition we formulate an optimal control problem involving preventive measures, the investment in vaccination of susceptible humans and the investment related to insecticide treatment. Numerical simulations are provided to illustrate the theoretical results.
journal: Analele Universității din Oradea fascicola Matematica

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to understand the global properties of dengue disease transmission and explore optimal control strategies for its prevention and management.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved the formulation of a mathematical model to represent the transmission dynamics of dengue fever, focusing on the global properties of the disease and the application of optimal control measures.
analysis.methods: The model was analyzed using Lyapunov stability theory and LaSalle's invariance principle to determine the stability of disease-free and endemic equilibria, and an optimal control problem was formulated to evaluate preventive measures.
analysis.main_results: The model demonstrated classical threshold behavior, with the disease-free equilibrium being locally and globally asymptotically stable when the basic reproduction number is less than one, and the endemic equilibrium being globally asymptotically stable when the basic reproduction number exceeds one under certain conditions.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as a theoretical framework for understanding dengue transmission dynamics and proposed optimal control strategies involving vaccination and insecticide treatment as novel approaches to disease management.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide a theoretical basis for developing targeted interventions such as vaccination programs and insecticide use to control dengue transmission and reduce disease burden.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a mathematical model and does not involve empirical data, which limits its applicability to real-world scenarios. The evidence is theoretical and derived from mathematical analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a mathematical model of dengue disease transmission dynamics, focusing on the global properties of the system and optimal control strategies. The model demonstrates classical threshold behavior, with stability of equilibria determined by the basic reproduction number. Theoretical results suggest that vaccination and insecticide treatment could be effective in managing dengue. The study provides a framework for understanding disease transmission but is limited to mathematical analysis without empirical validation. The findings have implications for public health strategies aimed at reducing dengue burden through targeted interventions.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to understand the global properties of dengue disease transmission and explore optimal control strategies for its prevention and management.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved the formulation of a mathematical model to represent the transmission dynamics of dengue fever, focusing on the global properties of the disease and the application of optimal control measures.
elements_en.methods: The model was analyzed using Lyapunov stability theory and LaSalle's invariance principle to determine the stability of disease-free and endemic equilibria, and an optimal control problem was formulated to evaluate preventive measures.
elements_en.main_results: The model demonstrated classical threshold behavior, with the disease-free equilibrium being locally and globally asymptotically stable when the basic reproduction number is less than one, and the endemic equilibrium being globally asymptotically stable when the basic reproduction number exceeds one under certain conditions.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as a theoretical framework for understanding dengue transmission dynamics and proposed optimal control strategies involving vaccination and insecticide treatment as novel approaches to disease management.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide a theoretical basis for developing targeted interventions such as vaccination programs and insecticide use to control dengue transmission and reduce disease burden.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a mathematical model and does not involve empirical data, which limits its applicability to real-world scenarios. The evidence is theoretical and derived from mathematical analysis.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解登革热疾病 传播 的整体特性,并探索其预防和管理的最佳控制策略。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及制定一个数学模型来表示 登革热 的 传播 动态,重点关注疾病的整体特性和最佳控制措施的应用。
elements_zh.methods: 利用李亚普诺夫稳定性理论和拉萨尔不变原理对模型进行分析,以确定无病平衡和地方病平衡的稳定性,并制定最优控制问题来评估预防措施。
elements_zh.main_results: 该模型表现出经典的阈值行为,当基本再生数小于 1 时,无病平衡局部和全局渐近稳定;当基本再生数在一定条件下超过 1 时,地方性平衡全局渐近稳定。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为理解登革热 传播 动态的理论框架,并提出了涉及 疫苗接种 和杀虫剂 治疗 的最佳控制策略,作为疾病管理的新方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为制定针对性干预措施(例如 疫苗接种 计划和使用杀虫剂来控制登革热 传播 和减轻疾病负担)提供了理论基础。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于数学模型,不涉及经验数据,这限制了其对现实场景的适用性。证据是理论上的,来自数学分析。

title_zh: 登革热疾病传播模型的全局特性及最优控制研究
source_body_en: In this work, we formulate a nonlinear system of differential equations that models the transmission dynamics of dengue fever. The model exhibits the classical threshold behavior. We prove that when the basic reproduction number is less than one, the disease-free equilibrium is locally and globally asymptotically stable and when the basic reproduction number is greater than one the endemic equilibrium is globally asymptotically stable under certain conditions. The stability of equilibria is derived through the use of Lyapunov stability theory and LaSalle's invariance principle. In addition we formulate an optimal control problem involving preventive measures, the investment in vaccination of susceptible humans and the investment related to insecticide treatment. Numerical simulations are provided to illustrate the theoretical results.
abstract_zh: 在这项工作中,我们制定了一个非线性微分方程组,对 登革热 的 传播 动力学进行建模。该模型表现出经典的阈值行为。我们证明,当基本再生数小于 1 时,无病平衡局部和全局渐近稳定;当基本再生数大于 1 时,地方性平衡在一定条件下全局渐近稳定。平衡的稳定性是通过利用李雅普诺夫稳定性理论和拉萨尔不变原理推导出来的。此外,我们还制定了一个最优控制问题,涉及预防措施、易感人群疫苗接种的投资以及与杀虫剂治疗相关的投资。提供数值模拟来说明理论结果。

title: Dominó da dengue: jogo educativo como estratégia de educação em saúde no Conhecendo a Unipampa
abstract: A dengue constitui um importante problema de saúde pública, cuja prevenção envolve a participação da comunidade, a Educação em Saúde e a identificação de fatores ambientais que favorecem a proliferação do mosquito Aedes aegypti. Nesse contexto, estratégias educativas e lúdicas podem aproximar os conhecimentos em saúde do cotidiano de crianças e adolescentes. Objetiva-se relatar a experiência de elaboração e utilização do jogo educativo “Dominó da Dengue” em uma atividade com estudantes da educação básica. Trata-se de um relato de experiência acerca de uma ação desenvolvida por acadêmicos da Universidade Federal do Pampa (UNIPAMPA), incluindo discentes vinculados ao Programa de Educação pelo Trabalho para a Saúde (PET-Saúde) Clima, durante o evento “Conhecendo a UNIPAMPA”, em Uruguaiana/RS. Participaram aproximadamente 30 estudantes de escolas visitantes, conforme estimativa dos responsáveis pela atividade, sem registro do quantitativo exato. O jogo foi elaborado com base na dinâmica tradicional do dominó, adaptada para abordar o mosquito vetor, a transmissão, os principais sinais e sintomas da dengue e as medidas de prevenção, incluindo a identificação e a eliminação de criadouros. Durante a atividade, os estudantes responderam às questões apresentadas nas peças e discutiram os conteúdos com os acadêmicos mediadores. Ao término, preencheram um instrumento elaborado pelos autores para registrar suas percepções sobre o jogo e a experiência vivenciada. A aplicação do recurso proporcionou situações de interação entre os estudantes e os mediadores, nas quais os conteúdos sobre dengue foram abordados por meio de perguntas, respostas e diálogo. A experiência articulou ludicidade e Educação em Saúde e promoveu a aproximação entre a universidade e a comunidade escolar. O preenchimento do instrumento possibilitou o registro das percepções dos participantes, constituindo uma fonte de informações para subsidiar o aprimoramento do recurso e de futuras atividades. Entretanto, a ausência de registro exato do número de participantes e de avaliação específica da aprendizagem limita as conclusões sobre os efeitos educativos do jogo. Conclui-se que o “Dominó da Dengue” constituiu um recurso para mediar a abordagem participativa da temática no contexto da atividade realizada. A experiência oferece subsídios para novas ações com a comunidade escolar, sendo necessárias avaliações sistemáticas para verificar sua contribuição para a aprendizagem e para as práticas de prevenção.
journal: Anais do VI Seminário (Des)Fazendo Saberes na Fronteira

analysis.summary_en: This study presents the experience of developing and using an educational game called "Dominó da Dengue" to teach students about dengue, its transmission, symptoms, and prevention. The game was created by academics from the Universidade Federal do Pampa (UNIPAMPA) during the "Conhecendo a UNIPAMPA" event in Uruguaiana/RS, involving approximately 30 students from visiting schools. The game was based on traditional domino dynamics, adapted to include information about the Aedes aegypti mosquito and dengue prevention measures. The activity facilitated interaction between students and mediators, allowing for discussion and dialogue on dengue-related topics. The game was seen as a tool to promote participatory learning and bridge the gap between academia and the school community. However, the lack of exact participant numbers and specific learning assessments limits the conclusions about the game's educational effects. The study highlights the potential of such games to enhance health education and community engagement in dengue prevention.

title_zh: 登革热多米诺骨牌:在 Unipampa 中开展教育教育战略
source_body_en: A dengue constitui um importante problema de saúde pública, cuja prevenção envolve a participação da comunidade, a Educação em Saúde e a identificação de fatores ambientais que favorecem a proliferação do mosquito Aedes aegypti. Nesse contexto, estratégias educativas e lúdicas podem aproximar os conhecimentos em saúde do cotidiano de crianças e adolescentes. Objetiva-se relatar a experiência de elaboração e utilização do jogo educativo “Dominó da Dengue” em uma atividade com estudantes da educação básica. Trata-se de um relato de experiência acerca de uma ação desenvolvida por acadêmicos da Universidade Federal do Pampa (UNIPAMPA), incluindo discentes vinculados ao Programa de Educação pelo Trabalho para a Saúde (PET-Saúde) Clima, durante o evento “Conhecendo a UNIPAMPA”, em Uruguaiana/RS. Participaram aproximadamente 30 estudantes de escolas visitantes, conforme estimativa dos responsáveis pela atividade, sem registro do quantitativo exato. O jogo foi elaborado com base na dinâmica tradicional do dominó, adaptada para abordar o mosquito vetor, a transmissão, os principais sinais e sintomas da dengue e as medidas de prevenção, incluindo a identificação e a eliminação de criadouros. Durante a atividade, os estudantes responderam às questões apresentadas nas peças e discutiram os conteúdos com os acadêmicos mediadores. Ao término, preencheram um instrumento elaborado pelos autores para registrar suas percepções sobre o jogo e a experiência vivenciada. A aplicação do recurso proporcionou situações de interação entre os estudantes e os mediadores, nas quais os conteúdos sobre dengue foram abordados por meio de perguntas, respostas e diálogo. A experiência articulou ludicidade e Educação em Saúde e promoveu a aproximação entre a universidade e a comunidade escolar. O preenchimento do instrumento possibilitou o registro das percepções dos participantes, constituindo uma fonte de informações para subsidiar o aprimoramento do recurso e de futuras atividades. Entretanto, a ausência de registro exato do número de participantes e de avaliação específica da aprendizagem limita as conclusões sobre os efeitos educativos do jogo. Conclui-se que o “Dominó da Dengue” constituiu um recurso para mediar a abordagem participativa da temática no contexto da atividade realizada. A experiência oferece subsídios para novas ações com a comunidade escolar, sendo necessárias avaliações sistemáticas para verificar sua contribuição para a aprendizagem e para as práticas de prevenção.

title: A tetravalent mRNA-LNP dengue vaccine incorporating antigen engineering confers broad protective immunity
abstract: The increasing global incidence of dengue highlights the urgent need for safe and broadly protective vaccines. Dengue virus (DENV) vaccination requires balanced immunity against four antigenically distinct serotypes while minimizing the risk of antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). Here, we developed a tetravalent mRNA-lipid nanoparticle (mRNA-LNP) vaccine incorporating an N8R substitution in the DENV envelope (E) protein and formulated with a novel ionizable lipid, AS-CL-28. Optimization of serotype-specific mRNA-LNP composition identified a 4:1:4:4 formulation (DENV1:DENV2:DENV3:DENV4) that reduced DENV2 immunodominance and improved the balance of neutralizing antibody responses across all four serotypes. Incorporation of the N8R substitution provided additional protective benefits against multiple DENV serotypes in passive protection models. Together, these findings provide a framework for developing next-generation tetravalent DENV mRNA vaccines that improve immune balance and protective efficacy while supporting future flavivirus vaccine design.

title_zh: 结合抗原工程的四价 mRNA-LNP 登革热 疫苗 赋予广泛的保护性免疫力
source_body_en: The increasing global incidence of dengue highlights the urgent need for safe and broadly protective vaccines. Dengue virus (DENV) vaccination requires balanced immunity against four antigenically distinct serotypes while minimizing the risk of antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). Here, we developed a tetravalent mRNA-lipid nanoparticle (mRNA-LNP) vaccine incorporating an N8R substitution in the DENV envelope (E) protein and formulated with a novel ionizable lipid, AS-CL-28. Optimization of serotype-specific mRNA-LNP composition identified a 4:1:4:4 formulation (DENV1:DENV2:DENV3:DENV4) that reduced DENV2 immunodominance and improved the balance of neutralizing antibody responses across all four serotypes. Incorporation of the N8R substitution provided additional protective benefits against multiple DENV serotypes in passive protection models. Together, these findings provide a framework for developing next-generation tetravalent DENV mRNA vaccines that improve immune balance and protective efficacy while supporting future flavivirus vaccine design.
abstract_zh: 全球登革热 疫苗 的增加凸显了对安全且具有广泛保护性的 疫苗 的迫切需求。登革病毒 (DENV) 疫苗接种 需要针对四种抗原不同血清型的平衡免疫力,同时最大限度地降低 抗体依赖性增强 (ADE) 的风险。在这里,我们开发了一种四价 mRNA-脂质纳米颗粒 (mRNA-LNP) 疫苗,在 DENV 包膜 (E) 蛋白中加入 N8R 取代,并用新型可电离脂质 AS-CL-28 配制。血清型特异性 mRNA-LNP 组成的优化确定了 4:1:4:4 配方 (DENV1:DENV2:DENV3:DENV4),可降低 DENV2 免疫优势并改善所有四种血清型中和抗体反应的平衡。N8R 替代的结合为被动保护模型中的多种 DENV 血清型提供了额外的保护作用。总之,这些发现为开发下一代四价 DENV mRNA 疫苗 提供了一个框架,可改善免疫平衡和保护功效,同时支持未来的黄病毒 疫苗 设计。

title: Stochastic Dengue Endemicity under Lévy Jump Fluctuations
abstract: Dengue resurgence poses major public-health challenges. Because transmission is affected by environmental and random fluctuations, realistic models are needed. We propose a stochastic dengue model, with a susceptible infectious recovered structure for humans and a susceptible infectious structure for mosquitoes, incorporating white noise and Levy jumps. We establish the existence and uniqueness of a global positive solution, prove moment and almost sure exponential stability of the disease-free equilibrium, derive sufficient conditions for persistence in mean, and illustrate the results numerically. The analysis clarifies how random fluctuations affect dengue transmission and its long-term variability.

title_zh: Lévy Jump 波动下的随机登革热流行
source_body_en: Dengue resurgence poses major public-health challenges. Because transmission is affected by environmental and random fluctuations, realistic models are needed. We propose a stochastic dengue model, with a susceptible infectious recovered structure for humans and a susceptible infectious structure for mosquitoes, incorporating white noise and Levy jumps. We establish the existence and uniqueness of a global positive solution, prove moment and almost sure exponential stability of the disease-free equilibrium, derive sufficient conditions for persistence in mean, and illustrate the results numerically. The analysis clarifies how random fluctuations affect dengue transmission and its long-term variability.
abstract_zh: 登革热的死灰复燃给公共卫生带来了重大挑战。由于传播受到环境和随机波动的影响,因此需要现实的模型。我们提出了一种随机登革热模型,具有人类易感传染性恢复结构和蚊子易感传染性结构,并结合了白噪声和 Levy 跳跃。我们建立了全局正解的存在性和唯一性,证明了无病平衡的矩稳定性和几乎确定的指数稳定性,导出了均值持续存在的充分条件,并以数值方式说明了结果。该分析阐明了随机波动如何影响登革热 传播 及其长期变异性。

title: Serotype-dependent fusion loop and pr antibody profiles in primary dengue virus infections
abstract: Abstract Dengue viruses (DENV1-4) are a leading cause of arboviral disease worldwide. The envelope (E) and premembrane (prM) proteins are major antibody targets; within E, the conserved fusion loop (FL) is an immunodominant cross-reactive epitope. Antibodies to pr and FL have been linked to antibody-dependent enhancement, yet their contribution to the cross-reactive response in polyclonal serum remains undefined. Here using recombinant antigens and a multiplexed serological assay with sera from the Nicaraguan Pediatric Dengue Cohort Study, we show that anti-pr responses are serotype-dependent in magnitude yet broadly cross-reactive among DENV1–4, with very limited ZIKV recognition. All primary DENV infections generated FL-reactive antibodies, but the E-FL fraction varied by infecting serotype and detection antigen, revealing asymmetric serotype-dependent shaping of cross-reactive responses. Interestingly, the greater the magnitude of cross-reactive E binding, the lower the proportion of FL-sensitive binding. These findings show that primary infection imprints serotype-specific patterns on cross-reactive antibody landscapes to dengue and Zika viruses that may influence subsequent infection outcomes.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand the serotype-dependent patterns of antibody responses to the fusion loop (FL) and prM proteins in primary dengue virus infections, addressing the gap in knowledge regarding the contribution of these antibodies to the cross-reactive response.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used sera from the Nicaraguan Pediatric Dengue Cohort Study, employing a multiplexed serological assay with recombinant antigens to investigate antibody responses in primary dengue virus infections.
analysis.methods: Antibody responses were measured using a multiplexed serological assay with recombinant antigens targeting the fusion loop (FL) and prM proteins from dengue viruses 1–4.
analysis.main_results: Anti-pr responses were serotype-dependent in magnitude but broadly cross-reactive among DENV1–4, with very limited Zika virus (ZIKV) recognition. Primary DENV infections generated FL-reactive antibodies, but the E-FL fraction varied by infecting serotype and detection antigen, revealing asymmetric serotype-dependent shaping of cross-reactive responses.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings show that primary infection imprints serotype-specific patterns on cross-reactive antibody landscapes to dengue and Zika viruses, which may influence subsequent infection outcomes.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results have implications for understanding the role of cross-reactive antibodies in dengue virus infections and may inform future studies on vaccine development and serological diagnostics.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the use of a single cohort and the focus on primary infections, which may not fully represent the broader population. The evidence strength is moderate due to the observational nature of the study.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated serotype-dependent patterns of antibody responses to the fusion loop and prM proteins in primary dengue virus infections, showing that anti-pr responses were broadly cross-reactive among DENV1-4, with limited ZIKV recognition. The findings suggest that primary infection imprints serotype-specific patterns on cross-reactive antibody landscapes, which may influence subsequent infection outcomes.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解原发性 登革病毒 感染中融合环 (FL) 和 prM 蛋白的抗体反应的血清型依赖性模式,弥补有关这些抗体对交叉反应反应的贡献的知识空白。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用尼加拉瓜儿童登革热 队列研究 研究的血清,采用重组抗原的多重血清学测定来研究原发性 队列研究 感染中的抗体反应。

elements_zh.main_results: 抗 pr 反应的强度取决于血清型,但在 DENV1-4 之间广泛存在交叉反应,对寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 的识别非常有限。原发性 DENV 感染产生 FL 反应性抗体,但 E-FL 部分因感染血清型和检测抗原而异,揭示了交叉反应反应的不对称血清型依赖性形状。

title_zh: 原发性 登革病毒 感染中血清型依赖性融合环和 pr 抗体谱
source_body_en: Abstract Dengue viruses (DENV1-4) are a leading cause of arboviral disease worldwide. The envelope (E) and premembrane (prM) proteins are major antibody targets; within E, the conserved fusion loop (FL) is an immunodominant cross-reactive epitope. Antibodies to pr and FL have been linked to antibody-dependent enhancement, yet their contribution to the cross-reactive response in polyclonal serum remains undefined. Here using recombinant antigens and a multiplexed serological assay with sera from the Nicaraguan Pediatric Dengue Cohort Study, we show that anti-pr responses are serotype-dependent in magnitude yet broadly cross-reactive among DENV1–4, with very limited ZIKV recognition. All primary DENV infections generated FL-reactive antibodies, but the E-FL fraction varied by infecting serotype and detection antigen, revealing asymmetric serotype-dependent shaping of cross-reactive responses. Interestingly, the greater the magnitude of cross-reactive E binding, the lower the proportion of FL-sensitive binding. These findings show that primary infection imprints serotype-specific patterns on cross-reactive antibody landscapes to dengue and Zika viruses that may influence subsequent infection outcomes.

title: Impacto epidemiológico del dengue y del chikungunya en zonas urbanas: revisión sistemática
abstract: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre el impacto epidemiológico urbano del dengue y del chikungunya. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios. Resultados: la incidencia mundial del dengue aumentó desde 1990, con diferencias regionales marcadas y alta carga en América Latina. El chikungunya se expandió por las Américas desde 2013 y produjo brotes urbanos explosivos, con manifestaciones articulares persistentes. La urbanización, la expansión de Aedes aegypti y Aedes albopictus y la resistencia a insecticidas favorecieron la transmisión. Destacan como estrategias las nuevas vacunas y el control vectorial integrado. Conclusión: ambas arbovirosis son una carga creciente para las ciudades tropicales y subtropicales y exigen vigilancia y control sostenidos.

analysis.research_question_and_background: El estudio buscaba sintetizar la evidencia sobre el impacto epidemiológico urbano del dengue y del chikungunya, con el objetivo de abordar la creciente carga de enfermedad en zonas urbanas tropicales y subtropicales.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Se realizó una revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en bases de datos como PubMed y SciELO, considerando estudios publicados entre 2012 y 2025; se incluyeron 15 estudios que abordaron el impacto de estos virus en diferentes regiones.
analysis.methods: La revisión sistemática se llevó a cabo en PubMed y SciELO, seleccionando estudios publicados entre 2012 y 2025. Se incluyeron 15 estudios que analizaron el impacto epidemiológico urbano del dengue y del chikungunya.
analysis.main_results: Los resultados mostraron que la incidencia mundial del dengue aumentó desde 1990, con diferencias regionales marcadas y una alta carga en América Latina. El chikungunya se expandió por las Américas desde 2013, causando brotes urbanos explosivos y manifestaciones articulares persistentes.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Los autores interpretaron que la urbanización, la expansión de Aedes aegypti y Aedes albopictus, así como la resistencia a insecticidas, han favorecido la transmisión de ambos virus. Esta revisión destacó la necesidad de nuevas vacunas y estrategias de control vectorial integrado.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Los hallazgos pueden informar estrategias de vigilancia y control sostenido en ciudades tropicales y subtropicales, donde el dengue y el chikungunya representan una carga epidemiológica significativa.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: La evidencia se basa en una revisión sistemática abstracto, lo que limita la profundidad de los análisis. Sin embargo, el estudio proporciona una síntesis generalizada de la literatura disponible, lo que justifica una confianza moderada en los hallazgos.

analysis.summary_en: Este estudio realiza una revisión sistemática para sintetizar la evidencia sobre el impacto epidemiológico urbano del dengue y del chikungunya. Se analizaron 15 estudios publicados entre 2012 y 2025, encontrando que la incidencia mundial del dengue aumentó desde 1990, con una alta carga en América Latina. Por otro lado, el chikungunya se expandió por las Américas desde 2013, causando brotes explosivos y manifestaciones articulares persistentes. Los autores destacaron que factores como la urbanización, la presencia de Aedes aegypti y Aedes albopictus, así como la resistencia a insecticidas, han favorecido la transmisión de ambos virus. Las implicaciones científicas y de salud pública incluyen la necesidad de nuevas vacunas y estrategias de control vectorial integrado. Aunque la evidencia se basa en una revisión abstracta, los hallazgos ofrecen una visión generalizada de la literatura disponible, lo que justifica una confianza moderada en los resultados.

title: O USO DA INTELIGÊNCIA ARTIFICIAL NA PREVISÃO DA DENGUE E DA INFLUENZA COMO APOIO AO PLANEJAMENTO DE INSUMOS LABORATORIAIS THE USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN FORECASTING DENGUE AND INFLUENZA TO SUPPORT LABORATORY SUPPLY PLANNING
abstract: This study examines the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in forecasting dengue and influenza and its contribution to laboratory supply management. A literature review was conducted, with a mixed-methods approach and descriptive design, based on scientific articles, official documents and public databases. Predictive models indicate in advance changes in disease behavior, although performance varies by region, period, variables and method. In the laboratory context, supply availability influences the diagnostic flow, and sudden changes in demand impair restocking. There is no evidence that this integration is already established. It is concluded that AI has potential to support laboratory management, provided that its forecasts are validated.
journal: Anais do Congresso Brasileiro de Iniciação Científica

title_zh: O USO DA INTELIGÊNCIA ARTIFICIAL NA PREVISIO DA DENUE E DA INFLUENZA COMO APOIO AO PLANEJAMENTO DE INSUMOS LABORATORIAIS 使用人工智能预测登革热和流感以支持实验室供应规划
source_body_en: This study examines the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in forecasting dengue and influenza and its contribution to laboratory supply management. A literature review was conducted, with a mixed-methods approach and descriptive design, based on scientific articles, official documents and public databases. Predictive models indicate in advance changes in disease behavior, although performance varies by region, period, variables and method. In the laboratory context, supply availability influences the diagnostic flow, and sudden changes in demand impair restocking. There is no evidence that this integration is already established. It is concluded that AI has potential to support laboratory management, provided that its forecasts are validated.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了人工智能 (AI) 在预测登革热和流感方面的应用及其对实验室供应管理的贡献。基于科学文章、官方文件和公共数据库,采用混合方法和描述性设计进行了文献综述。预测模型提前表明疾病行为的变化,尽管表现因地区、时期、变量和方法而异。在实验室环境中,供应可用性会影响诊断流程,而需求的突然变化会损害补货。没有证据表明这种整合已经建立。结论是,只要人工智能的预测得到验证,人工智能就有潜力支持实验室管理。

title: Multi-sectoral intervention against Aedes aegypti in Dengue outbreak management in Pontianak, West Kalimantan, Indonesia
abstract: Dengue fever is a viral infection that is transmitted through the Aedes aegypti mosquito and is prevalent in tropical and subtropical areas. Pontianak, as the provincial capital of West Kalimantan, Indonesia, is an endemic place for dengue fever. Dengue fever has become a significant burden on public health, especially in a developing country like Indonesia. Besides being influenced by population growth and increasing mobility, dengue fever is now notably worsened by climate change and environmental degradation. Generally, dengue fever management mainly focuses on eliminating the vector: Aedes aegypti mosquito, to end the virus transmission. However, multi-sectoral intervention is also crucial to complement the health intervention in the community, making synergies among stakeholders in addressing Dengue fever. Hence, the responsibility to stop the Dengue outbreak is not only the role of the health sector, but also for the corporations, policymakers, research and educational institutions, and the government.

abstract_zh: 登革热 是一种通过埃及伊蚊传播的病毒感染,在热带和亚热带地区流行。坤甸作为印度尼西亚西加里曼丹省的省会,是登革热的流行地。登革热 已成为公共卫生的重大负担,特别是在印度尼西亚这样的发展中国家。除了受到人口增长和流动性增加的影响外,登革热 现在还受到气候变化和环境退化的影响。一般来说,登革热管理主要集中在消灭媒介:埃及伊蚊,以消灭病毒传播。然而,多部门干预对于补充社区健康干预也至关重要,使利益相关者在解决 登革热 问题上发挥协同作用。因此,阻止登革热 暴发 不仅是卫生部门的责任,也是企业、政策制定者、研究和教育机构以及政府的责任。

title: DEXTRAN ADMINISTRATION AND ACUTE KIDNEY INJURY IN PEDIATRIC DENGUE SHOCK SYNDROME: A MULTICENTER PROPENSITY SCORE-MATCHED COHORT STUDY
abstract: Background: Acute kidney injury (AKI) complicates up to 10% of dengue virus infections, with the risk increasing with disease severity. Dextran-40, recommended as first-line colloid therapy for dengue shock syndrome (DSS) in Thailand's national guidelines, has theoretical nephrotoxic potential; however, evidence regarding its association with AKI in children with DSS remains limited. Methods: This multicenter observational cohort study included children under 15 years diagnosed with DSS and admitted to six hospitals in Thailand between January 2012 and December 2024. Patients with refractory shock requiring inotropes within the first hour, bleeding complications, or AKI prior to fluid resuscitation were excluded. AKI was defined according to the KDIGO criteria. Propensity score matching was performed to balance baseline covariates between dextran-40 recipients and comparators. Univariable and multivariable logistic regression analyses were performed to identify factors associated with AKI. Results: Of 650 patients assessed, 604 were included in the cohort, and 592 were included in the final propensity score–matched cohort, with post matching absolute standardized mean differences 60 minutes after initiation of fluid resuscitation was independently associated with increased odds of AKI in both the primary and severity-adjusted models, a finding that persisted in the subgroup of patients receiving dextran-40 specifically for shock. A higher cumulative dextran-40 dose was associated with increased odds of AKI in the primary model, but this association was attenuated after adjustment for disease severity. Conclusion: Dextran-40 administration was not independently associated with AKI; instead, delayed administration (>60 minutes after fluid resuscitation initiation) and disease severity, particularly refractory shock and DHF grade IV, were the key potentially modifiable and non-modifiable predictors of AKI risk, respectively. These findings support continued use of dextran-40 as colloid therapy in pediatric DSS while emphasizing the importance of timely administration to minimize AKI risk.

analysis.summary_en: This multicenter observational cohort study investigated the association between dextran-40 administration and acute kidney injury (AKI) in children with dengue shock syndrome (DSS). The study found that delayed administration of dextran-40 (>60 minutes after fluid resuscitation initiation) and disease severity, particularly refractory shock and DHF grade IV, were independently associated with increased AKI risk. The results contribute to understanding the risk factors for AKI in severe dengue cases and may inform clinical guidelines for managing DSS in children.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 急性肾损伤 (AKI) 使高达 10% 的 登革病毒 感染变得复杂,且风险随着疾病严重程度的增加而增加。登革病毒 感染,尤其是 重症登革热,由于可能导致 AKI,因此构成了重大的公共卫生问题,需要进一步调查风险因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项多中心观察性 队列研究 研究纳入了 2012 年 1 月至 2024 年 12 月期间被诊断患有登革热休克综合征 (DSS) 并入住泰国六家医院的 15 岁以下儿童。排除了在第一小时内需要正性肌力药物、出血并发症或液体复苏前 AKI 的难治性休克患者。
elements_zh.methods: AKI 根据 KDIGO 标准定义。进行倾向评分匹配以平衡 dextran-40 接受者和比较者之间的基线协变量。进行单变量和多变量逻辑回归分析以确定与 AKI 相关的因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 在评估的 650 名患者中,604 名患者被纳入 队列研究,592 名患者被纳入最终倾向评分匹配的 队列研究。延迟给药(开始液体复苏后> 60 分钟)和疾病严重程度,特别是难治性休克和 DHF IV 级,与 AKI 几率增加独立相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,延迟给予 dextran-40 和疾病严重程度,而不是给药本身,是 AKI 风险的关键预测因素。这一发现凸显了及时干预治疗登革热休克综合征的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为临床实践提供了信息,支持继续使用 dextran-40 作为儿童登革热休克综合征的胶体疗法,同时强调需要及时给药以降低 AKI 风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是观察性的,依赖于倾向评分匹配,这可能无法完全消除混杂因素。由于控制所有潜在混杂因素的局限性,证据是中等的。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为临床实践提供了信息,支持继续使用 dextran-40 作为儿童登革热休克综合征的胶体疗法,同时强调需要及时给药以降低 AKI 风险。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是观察性的,依赖于倾向评分匹配,这可能无法完全消除混杂因素。由于控制所有潜在混杂因素的局限性,证据是中等的。

title: Estrategias de prevención del dengue en comunidades urbanas: revisión sistemática Dengue prevention strategies in urban communities: a systematic review
abstract: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre la efectividad de las estrategias de prevención del dengue en comunidades urbanas y su aplicabilidad al contexto ecuatoriano. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas con y sin metaanálisis, estudios en Ecuador, intervenciones comunitarias y una evaluación económica. Resultados: el control químico aislado redujo los índices entomológicos sin efecto demostrado sobre la transmisión. El manejo ambiental con participación comunitaria, las mallas en las viviendas y las cubiertas de recipientes mostraron los resultados más favorables. El almacenamiento de agua, la percepción del riesgo y la falta de servicios básicos condicionaron la prevención en Ecuador. Conclusión: la prevención del dengue urbano requiere estrategias integradas, comunitarias y sostenidas, con vigilancia epidemiológica y mejoras de los servicios básicos.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review aims to synthesize evidence on the effectiveness of dengue prevention strategies in urban communities and assess their applicability to the Ecuadorian context.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A systematic review was conducted using PubMed and SciELO databases from 2012 to 2025. The evidence includes 15 studies: systematic reviews with and without meta-analyses, studies conducted in Ecuador, community interventions, and an economic evaluation.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review found that integrated, community-based, and sustained strategies, including environmental management, window screens, and covered water containers, showed the most favorable results in dengue prevention. However, chemical control alone reduced entomological indices without demonstrated impact on transmission.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that factors such as water storage practices, risk perception, and lack of basic services influenced prevention effectiveness in Ecuador. There is no explicit mention of conflicting findings or heterogeneity in the results.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review concludes that dengue prevention in urban areas requires integrated, community-based, and sustained strategies, along with epidemiological surveillance and improvements in basic services.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review evaluates dengue prevention strategies in urban communities, focusing on their effectiveness and applicability in Ecuador. The evidence base includes 15 studies from PubMed and SciELO, spanning 2012 to 2025, encompassing systematic reviews, community interventions, and economic evaluations. Key findings indicate that integrated, community-based, and sustained strategies, such as environmental management, window screens, and covered water containers, yielded the most favorable outcomes. However, chemical control alone reduced entomological indices without clear evidence of impact on transmission. The review emphasizes the need for strategies that incorporate epidemiological surveillance and improvements in basic services to effectively prevent dengue in urban settings. The study also notes that factors like water storage practices, risk perception, and lack of basic services influenced prevention success in Ecuador. The implications suggest a focus on community engagement and long-term, sustainable interventions to address dengue in urban populations.

title: Mitochondrial Remodeling and Metabolic Reprogramming in the Dengue-Infected Liver: A Proposed Link Between Viral Tropism and Hepatic Steatosis
abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) infection is frequently associated with biochemical evidence of liver injury, and hepatic steatosis has been reported in severe and fatal cases. However, direct evidence connecting hepatocyte infection to steatosis remains fragmented across cell lines, animal models, and autopsy studies. This review evaluates mitochondrial remodeling as a candidate link between hepatic infection and altered lipid handling. DENV proteins perturb mitochondrial dynamics, respiration, redox balance, and innate immune signaling, and impaired mitochondrial quality control has also been observed in infected cells. Changes in glucose and lipid metabolism have been reported across these models. Some hepatoma studies report increased fatty acid oxidation during productive infection, whereas other experimental conditions are associated with impaired mitochondrial function. A temporal transition between these responses has not been established. Inflammatory signaling from hepatic immune cells may further impair insulin signaling and promote liver injury, although a direct causal pathway to steatosis remains unproven. This review focuses on hepatic outcomes and distinguishes observations made in human liver tissue, in DENV-exposed hepatic models, in other DENV-infected cell types, and in non-dengue liver disease. For each proposed step we identify the endpoint that was measured and whether the evidence is descriptive, associative, or mechanistically tested.

However, direct evidence connecting hepatocyte infection to steatosis remains fragmented across cell lines, animal models, and autopsy studies. For each proposed step we identify the endpoint that was measured and whether the evidence is descriptive, associative, or mechanistically tested.
abstract_zh: 登革病毒 (DENV) 感染经常与肝损伤的生化证据相关,并且在严重和致命的病例中已有肝脂肪变性的报道。然而,在细胞系、动物模型和尸检研究中,将肝细胞感染与脂肪变性联系起来的直接证据仍然支离破碎。这篇综述评估了线粒体重塑作为肝脏感染和脂质处理改变之间的候选联系。DENV 蛋白扰乱线粒体动力学、呼吸、氧化还原平衡和先天免疫信号,并且在受感染的细胞中还观察到线粒体质量控制受损。这些模型中已经报道了葡萄糖和脂质代谢的变化。一些肝癌研究报告说,在生产性感染期间脂肪酸氧化增加,而其他实验条件则与线粒体功能受损有关。这些反应之间的时间过渡尚未确定。尽管脂肪变性的直接因果途径尚未得到证实,但肝脏免疫细胞的炎症信号传导可能会进一步损害胰岛素信号传导并促进肝损伤。本综述重点关注肝脏结果,并区分在人类肝脏组织、暴露于 DENV 的肝脏模型、其他感染 DENV 的细胞类型和非登革热肝病中进行的观察。对于每个提议的步骤,我们都会确定测量的终点以及证据是否是描述性的、关联性的或机械性测试的。

title: CARTÃO DE ACOMPANHAMENTO DA DENGUE: PRÁTICAS INOVADORAS DE AÇÕES EM SAÚDE
abstract: A Dengue, doença endêmica nos países que apresentam clima tropical e subtropical, especialmente nas áreas urbanas e suburbanas, é transmitida pela picada da fêmea do mosquito Aedes Aegypti. No Brasil, o vírus dessa patologia febril apresenta quatro sorotipos e no último ano foram notificados quase 1,5 milhão de casos no país. Com isso, o “Projeto Zelar” objetiva o desenvolvimento de medidas que possam garantir um melhor manejo dos pacientes infectados. O presente trabalho foi desenvolvido a partir de dados coletados na Atenção Primária e no Setor de Epidemiologia da cidade de Passos / MG, município em que o projeto foi aplicado, de modo que foi possível elencar os principais pontos deficitários a serem atenuados para que os pacientes possam ser adequadamente tratados. Para que fosse possível atingir este objetivo, foi realizado um evento que contou com diversos ouvintes da área da saúde e nele foram ofertadas palestras sobre a importância da notificação compulsória de um diagnóstico de Dengue, quais os sinais de alerta da doença e como deve ser feita a triagem e o manejo dos pacientes. Além disso, também foi desenvolvido o “Cartão de Manejo e Acompanhamento do Paciente com Suspeita de Dengue”, por meio do qual foram fornecidas orientações gerais aos pacientes como também uma área aonde é possível registros clínicos e laboratoriais do paciente para seu acompanhamento. Com tal projeto, foi possível concluir que os profissionais da saúde devem estar sempre em processo de aperfeiçoamento, para que dessa maneira os pacientes recebam as medidas necessárias de tratamento, evitando agravos.
